for(i=0; i < N; i++)
    C[i] = A[i] + B[i];

docs.title: Model 1:Sequential(SISD)
docs.text:
Can be executed on three processors

  1. Pipelined processor
  2. Out-of-order execution processor
    • Independent instructions executed when ready
    • Different iterations are present in the instruction window and can execute in parallel in multiple function units
  3. Superscalar or VILW processor
    • Can fetch and execute mutiple instructions per cycle

docs.title: Model 2:Data Parallel(SIMD)
docs.text:
• Motivation: Each iteration is independent
  • Idea: Programmer or compiler generates a SIMD instruction to execute the same instruction from all interations across different data

docs.title: Model 3:Multithreaded
docs.text:
• Realization: Each iteration is independent

  • Idea: Programmer or compiler generates a thread to execute each iteration. Each thread does the same thing(but on different data)

  • This programming model(software) is called SPMD

docs.title: SPMD
docs.text:
• SPMD: Single Procedure/Program, Multiple Data
  • Key Idea:
    • Each program/procedure 1.works on different data 2.can excute a different control-flow path at run-time
    • Many scientific applications are programmed this way and run on MIMD hardware(multiprocessors)
    • Modern GPUs programmed in a similar way on a SIMD hardware

docs.title: GPU Programming Example——CUDA
docs.text:
The device(typically GPU) executes CUDA kernels:

  • Grid: the whole set of threads
  • Thread Block
    • CUDA runtime schedules at granularity of thread block
    • A thread block is a programming abstraction that represents a group of threads that can be executed in parallel
    • Within a block, shared memory, and synchronization
  • Thread: a thread corresponds to an iteration

  • CUDA Memory Hierarchy

docs.title: CUDA Programing
docs.text:
• Function prototypes

    • float serialFunction(...)
    • __global__ void kernel(...)

  • main()

    1. Allocate memory on the device: cudaMalloc(&d_in, bytes)
    2. Transfer data from host to device: cudaMemCpy(d_in, h_in,...)
    3. Execution configuration setup: #block and #thread
    4. kernel call: kernel<<<execution config>>>(args)
    5. Transfer results from device to host: cudaMemCpy(h_out,d_out,...)

  • Kernel: __global__ void kernel(type args,...)

    • Automatic variables transparently assigned to registers
    • Shared memory: __shared__
    • Intra-block synchronization: __syncthreads

CUDA Programming Language

  • Memory allocation
    • cudaMalloc((void**)&d_in, #bytes)
  • Memory copy
    • cudaMemcpy(d_in, h_in, #bytes, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice)
  • Kernel launch
    • kernel<<<#blocks, #threads >>>(args)
  • Memory deallocation
    • cudaFree(d_in)
Vector Addition
  • Key Idea: one GPU thread to each element-wise addition

  • Group threads into blocks

  • Code:

//host code
void vecadd(float* A, float* B, float* C, int N){
    //1, Allocate CPU memory
    float *A_d, *B_d, *C_d;
    cudaMalloc((void**) &A_d, N*sizeof(float));
    cudaMalloc((void**) &B_d, N*sizeof(float));
    cudaMalloc((void**) &C_d, N*sizeof(float));

    //2, Copy data to GPU memory
    cudaMemcpy(A_d, A, N*sizeof(float), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice);
    cudaMemcpy(B_d, B, N*sizeof(float), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice);

    //3, Perform computation on GPU
    const unsigned int numThreadsPerBlock = 512;
    const unsigned int numBlocks = (N + numThreadsPerBlock -1)/numThreadsPerBlock;
    vecadd_kernel <<<numBlocks, numThreadsPerBlock>>>(A_d, B_d, C_d, N);

    //4, Copy data from GPU memory
    cudaMemcpy(C, C_d, N*sizeof(float), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost);

    //5, Deallocate GPU memory
    cudaFree(A_d);
    cudaFree(B_d);
    cudaFree(C_d);

    //kernel code
    __global__ void vecadd_kernel(float* A, float* B, float* C, int N){
        int i = blockDim.x*blockIdx.x + threadIdx.x;
        if(i < N)
            C[i] = A[i] + B[i];
        //blockIdx: block index within a grid
        //threadIdx: thread index within a block
    }
}

docs.title: SIMT(hardware) & Warp(software)
docs.text:
• SIMT: Single Instruction Multiple Thread
    • key feature: 16 CUDA cores in a SM are executed in a lock step
  • Warp:
    • A warp, a basic execution unit, consists of 32 consecutive threads
    • A thread block is divided into warps for SIMT execution
  • Why: to reduce schedule overhead
for(i=0; i < N; i++)
    C[i] = A[i] + B[i];

GPU execution with Warps

  • Assume: a warp consists of 32 threads
  • If you have 32K iterations, and 1 iteration/thread -> 1K warps
  • Warps can be interleaved on the same pipeline -> Fine grained multithreading of warps

docs.title: SIMD vs. SIMT execution model
docs.text:
• SIMD: A single sequential instruction stream of SIMD instructions -> each instruction specifies multiple data inputs
  • SIMT: Multiple instruction streams of scalar instructions -> threads grouped dynamically into warps

Two Major SIMT Advantages:

  • Can treat each thread separately -> i.e., can execute each thread independently on any type of scalar pipeline -> MIMD processing
  • Can group threads into warps flexibly -> i.e., can group threads that are supposed to truly execute the same instruction -> dynamically obtain and maximize benefits of SIMD processing

docs.title: Warp-based SIMD vs. Traditional SIMD
docs.text:
​根据​图片​内容​，​将​两种​ SIMD ​模式​的​对比​整理​成​表格​如下​：

​对比​维度​ Traditional SIMD Warp-based SIMD ​线程​模型​ ​包含​单个​线程​ ​包含​多个​标量​线程​ ​执行​方式​ ​顺序​指令​执行​，SIMD​指令​内锁步​操作​ ​以​ SIMD ​方式​执行​（​即​所有​线程​执行​同​一条​指令​），​但​不​一定​是​锁步​ ​编程​模型​ SIMD ​编程​模型​（​无​额外​线程​）→ ​软件​需要​知道​向量​长度​ ​不是​ SIMD ​编程​模型​，​每个​线程​可​单独​处理​（​例如​放入​不同​的​ warp）→ ​软件​不​需要​知道​向量​长度​，​支持​多线程​和​灵活​的​动态​线程​分组​ ​指令集​架构​ (ISA) ​包含​向量​ / SIMD ​指令​ ​标量​ ISA，SIMD ​操作​可​动态​形成​ ​本质​定位​ — ​基于​ SIMD ​硬件​实现​的​ SPMD ​编程​模型

docs.title: Introduction
docs.text:
Toc:

  • Von Neumann Model
  • Instruction Set Architecture
  • Instruction Processing Cycle
  • Single-Cycle CPU
  • Multi-Cycle CPU
  • Pipelined CPU

docs.title: Properties
docs.text:
• Zere latency: zero access time
  • Infinite capacity: no swap out
  • Infinite bandwidth: to support multiple accesses in parallel
  • Zere cost: provide as many as needed

docs.title: Problems
docs.text:
• Bigger is slower: takes longer to determine the location
  • Faster is more expensive: SRAM, DRAM, SSD, Disk, Tape
  • Higher bandwidth is more expensive

docs.title: Comparison
docs.text:
• Flip-Flops(~K)
    • very fast, parallel access
    • very expensive(1 bit costs tens of transistors)
  • Static RAM(~M)
    • Relatively fast, only one data word at a time
    • Expensive(1 bit costs 6+ transistors)
  • Dynamic RAM(~G)
    • Slow, one data word at a time, reading destorys content(refresh)
    • Cheap(1 bit cost 1 transistor + 1 capacitor)
  • Flash Memory(~T)
    • Much slower, non-volatile
    • Very cheap(1 transistor stores 16 bits or no transistors involved)

docs.title: Array Organization of Memories
docs.text:
• Goal: Efficiently store large amounts of data
    • A memory array(store data)
    • Address selection logic(selects one row of the array)
    • Readout circuitry(reads data out)

An array with N address bits and M data bits:

  • \(2^N\) rows and columns
  • Depth: number of rows(number of words)
  • Width: number of columns(size of word)
  • Array size: depth \(\times\) width = \(2^N\times M\)

docs.title: Memory Array Organization
docs.text:
• Bitline: Storage nodes in one column connected to one bitline
  • Wordline: Address decoder activates only ONE wordline, content of one line of storage available at output

docs.title: SRAM
docs.text:
• Goal: buffering data on chip to reduce external memory traffic
  • Advantage: random access still keeps high performance
  • Disadvantage: low capacity(multiple MBs)

Where to use SRAM

  • Cache in CPU(half chip area is occupied by cache)
  • Shared memory in GPU
  • On-chip buffer in AI accelerator

How to use SRAM

  • Multiple small separate SRAMs: low latency and high throughput
  • Banked design: wide access ports

docs.title: Memory Banking
docs.text:
• Memory is divided into banks that can be accessed independently; banks share address and data buses(to minimize pin cost)
  • Can start and complete one bank access per cycle
  • Can sustain N concurrent accesses if all N go to different banks
  • Memory bank access:
  • SRAM access:

docs.title: DRAM
docs.text:
• Motivation and Goals
    • Application Perspective
    • Performance Perspective
    • Reliablity Perspective

Key memory behind memory:

  • Memory Optimizations aim at size, bandwidth, not latency
  • A memory read/write may need a few DDR operations
  • Different access sequence leads to different throughput
    • sequential(mainly row buffer hit) > random(mainly row buffer miss)
  • Random access is slow due to low row buffer miss rate

docs.title: DRAM technology
docs.text: • Goal: building larger memories->require larger memory arrays

docs.title: General Principle: Interleaving(Banking)
docs.text:
• Problem: a single monolithic large memory array takes long to access and does not enable multiple access in parallel
  • Goal: Reduce the latency of memory array access and enable multiple accesses in parallel
  • Idea: Divide a large array into multiple banks that can be accessed independently (in the same cycle or in consecutive cycles)
  • A key issue: How to map data to different banks?(i.e., how to interleave data across banks)

docs.title: DRAM Architecture
docs.text:
• DRAM Subsystem Orgnization

  • Breaking down a DIMM(dual in-line memory module)

  • Breaking down a Rank

  • Breaking down a Chip

  • Breaking down a Bank

docs.title: DRAM Refresh
docs.text:
• DRAM capacitor charge leaks over time
  • The memomry controller needs to refresh each row periodically to restore charge
    • Activate each row every N(like 64) ms
  • Downsides of refresh:
    • Energy consumption
    • Performance degradation: DRAM rank/bank unavailable while refreshed
    • QoS/predictability impact:(Long) pause times during refresh
    • Refresh rate limits DRAM capacity scaling

docs.title: DRAM vs SRAM
docs.text: 特性​ DRAM SRAM ​访问速度​ ​慢​（​因​电容​充放电​） ​快​（​无​电容​，​直接​用​晶体管​锁存​） ​存储密度​ ​高​（1T1C ​单元​） ​低​（6T ​单元​） ​成本​ ​低​ ​高​ ​刷新​需求​ ​需要​（​功耗​、​性能​、​电路​开销​） ​不​需要​ ​制造​工艺​ ​需​将​电容​与​逻辑电路​集成​ ​与​标准​逻辑​工艺​兼容​（​无​电容​）

docs.title: HBM
docs.text:
• HBM stack
    • used in conjunction with high-end GPUs, AI ASICs and FPGAs
    • each stack has 4/8 DRAM dies and logic die

docs.title: Advatages and Dis
docs.text:
Advantage:

  • High bandwidth: ~500GB/s per stack
  • Low power consumption: due to running without termination

Disadvantage:

  • Less flexibility: fixed, in the same package with compute chip
  • Low capacity: really close to compute chip
  • High cost: strict condition

docs.title: NVME SSD
docs.text:
• advantage: large memory size
  • disadvantage: low throughput, high latency, hard to use

docs.title: Parallel Training
docs.text: • Four Components of AI System:

docs.title: Neural Network training
docs.text:
1. Start with randomly initialized weights
  2. Iterate through your data a mini-batch of training data samples at a time:
    • Forward pass
    • Backward pass
    • Weight update

Here is an example, Each layer:

  • Input: vector
  • Output: vector
  • Learned parameters (weights): projection matrix
  • Operations:
    1. Multiply the input vector with the matrix
    2. Apply a point-wise nonlinearity, say, ReLU

Forward Pass:

  • A minibatch of 2 samples:

Compute Loss:

  • Loss function: Produces a loss value that indicates how “wrong” the network was
    • Compares the output to the ground truth for each sample
    • Exact function math varies by task
  • Goal of training: minimize the loss value
    • Update network weights so the predicted output closely matches ground truth

Backward Pass:

  • Goal: compute the gradients to the layer weights
  • Implementation: “back propagating” the loss through layers
    • Each layer computes weight gradient, used to update the weights
    • Each layer computes activation gradient, to be backpropagated to preceding layer

Backward Pass-Compute dW:

Weight Update:

  • SGD:
    • Input: Weight W, gradient dW
    • Output: updated weight
    • Operation: Increment each weight with the corresponding gradient value

  • Momentum:

    • Input: Weight W, gradient dW
    • States: 1 momenta (～model)
    • Output: updated weight
    • Operation: Update internal state with weight gradient, then update weights using internal state

    - Adam: - States: 1 momentum, 1 variance - reading and updating momentum/variance/parameters

One Iteration for a layer:

docs.title: Why Distributed Training
docs.text:
• Challenge from Model Side: Larger models
    • Language models (GPT-3): 175B parameters
    • Recommender models: largest ones are reaching O(1B) parameters
    • Vision models: deeper and wider Resnets and ResNeXTs
  • Challenge from Dataset Side: Larger datasets
    • Recommender data (user behavior): terabytes to petabytes
    • Image data: 1B Instagram dataset, JFT (300M images)
  • Challenge from System Side:
    • The memory size of a single accelerator, e.g., GPU, is 80GB.

Therefore, the solution is scaling out computing

  • Parallelism Taxonomy:

docs.title: Data Parallelism
docs.text:
Each worker:

  • Model: has a copy of the entire neural network model
  • Dataset: responsible for compute of a portion of data (training minibatch)

docs.title: Forward Pass
docs.text:
• Computes output activations for its portion of minibatch

  • No communication is needed

docs.title: Backward Pass
docs.text:
• Computes activation gradients for its portion of minibatch

  • Computes contribution to the weight gradient based on its portion of minibatch

    • All workers’ contributions must be summed before weight update

docs.title: Weight Update
docs.text:
1. Each of N workers accumulates gradients:

    • Summing 1/N gradients collected from (N – 1) peers

  2. Each worker updates its model:

    • Each worker updates its copy of the model with combined gradients from all 4 workers

docs.title: AllReduce Implementation Choices
docs.text:
“Ring” AllReduce (Baidu):

  • For any topology that contains a 1D torus (ring)
  • Each worker communicates with 2 neighbors
  • 2(N – 1) steps, worker sends/receives 1/N of all bytes
    • Each step requires a synchronization -> 2(N – 1) syncs total
    • Each worker needs CPU and GPU cycles to do ring AllReduce

docs.title: "Ring" AllReduce two stages
docs.text:
1. Reduce_scatter: N-1 rounds, M/N data per round

  2. Allgather: N-1 rounds, M/N data per round

  3. N: number of GPUs, M: data size

AllReduce Example

  • #GPU = 4

  • Initial States: Partitioning of an array into N=4 chunks

  • Reduce_scatter stage:

  • Allgather stage:

“In-switch” AllReduce:

  • Each worker communicates with the switch
  • Only one step, a worker sends/receives N of all bytes
    • All workers work in a lock step.

docs.title: Challenges
docs.text:
Strong scaling (increase the number of workers, keep minibatch size constant)

  • Certain layers require minimum minibatch sizes to properly operate
    • Example: batch normalization (BN) generally requires 16+ samples
  • Maybe lower GPU utilization

Weak scaling (increase the number of workers, increase minibatch size)

  • Training networks with large minibatches requires hyper-parameter adjustment
    • Learning rate schedule, BN decay, …
    • Example: R50 (SGD up to bs=16K, LARS above 16K, …)
  • Often increase the amount of work required to reach the same model accuracy

Workload Increasing with Batch Size:

  • Epochs to reach the same model accuracy(from various submissions to MLPerf v0.7)

docs.title: Model Parallelism
docs.text:
• Inter-layer Parallel (aka Pipeline Parallel): A worker is responsible for its portion of the layers

    - Intra-layer Parallel (aka Tensor Parallel): A worker is responsible for its portion of each layer

docs.title: Pipeline parallel
docs.text:
• Pipeline Parallel Training:

  • Idle bubbles: 12/18 step-slots

  • For N workers: (N-1)/N idle slots

docs.title: Pipeline Parallel Training: GPipe
docs.text:
• Key idea: subminibatches

  • 2 subminibatches

    • 2x more steps
    • Each step is 1/2 comput
  • Idle bubbles: 12/24 step-slots
  • N workers, K subminibatches:
    • 2(N+K-1) steps for fwd/bwd
    • Total step-slots: 2N(N+K-1)
    • Idle step-slots: 2N(N-1)
    • Fraction of idle slots: (N-1)/(N+K-1)
      • K=N -> 50%
      • K=4N -> 20%

docs.title: Pipeline Parallel: Communication
docs.text:
• A worker communicates with its 2 neighbors

    • 1D mesh topology
    • 1D torus when interleaving layers

  • Communication in each step of the fwd and bwd pass

    • Activations in fwd, activation gradients in bwd

  • Overlap communication with computation

    • Very hard

docs.title: Pipeline Parallel: Challenges
docs.text:
• Load balancing workload across workers is difficult
    • Different layers of a network can take different amounts of time
    • Leads to even busy slots for other workers idling for portions of time
  • Lots of computation to hide communication
  • Idle slots reduce scaling efficiency
    • Many subminibatches help with this, but run into the same problems as strong-scaling of data-parallel.

docs.title: Tensor parallelism
docs.text:
• Idea: Partition a given layer's weights among the workers
  • Address some of the pipeline parallel challenges
    • idle slots, load imbalance

  • Two variants:

    • Row-wise partitioning
    • Column-wise partitioning

docs.title: Row-wise Partitioning: Allgather between Layers
docs.text:
Each worker:

  • W: Has a portion of weight rows
  • X: All of input activations X
  • Y: Computes a portion of output activations

docs.title: Column-wise Partitioning: ReduceScatter between Layers
docs.text:
Each worker:

  • W: Has a portion of weight rows
  • X: All of input activations X
  • Y: Computes a portion of output activations

docs.title: Reducing Synchronization By Alternating Partitioning
docs.text:
• Note: no communication is needed for two matrices
  • Worker i produces output, which is its input for the next layer

docs.title: Intra-Layer Parallel: Communication
docs.text:
• Row-wise in forward becomes Col-wise in backward
  • Col-wise in forward becomes Row-wise in backward
  • Row-wise:
    • Fwd: allgather
    • Bwd: reduce_scatter
  • Col-wise:
    • Fwd: reduce_scatter
    • Bwd: allgather
  • When row- and col- are alternated:
    • Allreduce every two layers, in fwd and bwd
    • Halves the synchronizations compared to not alternating

docs.title: Application
docs.text:
• Tensor Parallelism for Transformer Block：

  • Attention: column-wise + row-wise.

  • MLP: column-wise + row-wise.

docs.title: Communication Pattern Review
docs.text:
Communication Pattern Summary:

  • Data Parallel:

    • Allreduce of weights
    • Can be overlapped with computation

  • Pipeline Parallel:

    • Point-wise communication of activations and activation gradients
    • Hard to overlap with computation
    • Hard to load-balance

  • Tensor Parallel:

    • Allgather, Reduce_scatter of activations and activation gradients
    • Allreduce if row-wise and col-wise partitioning is alternated
    • Hard to overlap with computation

docs.title: Summary
docs.text:
• Networks and dataset are getting larger to set new state of art results
  • Scale-out enables these neural networks to be trained

Success requires many optimized components:

  • Hardware:

    • Fast accelerators for DL
    • High-bandwidth, low-latency interconnects

  • Software:

    • Math libraries (CUDNN, CUBLAS, MKL, CANN …)
    • Collective communication libraries (NCCL, Horovod, …)
    • Training frameworks (MindSpore, PyTorch, TensoFlow, HugeCTR, …)
    • Proper choice of parallelism (manual, MeshTensorFlow, Gshard, ZeRO)

docs.title: Harzard
docs.text:
A hazard is a condition that prevents an instruction in the pipeline from executing its next scheduled pipe line stage.

Taxomomy:

  • structural hazards: Conflict due to limited hardware resources
  • Data harzards: Instruction depends on result of a prior instruction which is not ready (computed or stored) yet
  • Control harzards: Not able to fetch the next instruction for the next clock due to unsolved branch condition or unavailable branch

docs.title: Structural Hazard
docs.text:
• Reason: Occurs when two or more instructions try to use the same hardware resource in the same cycle.
  • Outcome: Causes bubble (stall) in a pipelined CPU.
  • Solution: Can be overcome by replicating hardware resources
    • Multiple accesses to the register file (2 reads, 1 write port to avoid structural hazard)
    • Multiple accesses to memory(i.e. instruction and data memory)
    • Fully pipeline the functional unit

docs.title: Data Dependences
docs.text:
Three Types of data dependences

  • Flow dependence (read after write – true data dependence)
  • Output dependence (write after write)
  • Anti dependence (write after read)
Flow dependence
r3 <-  r1  op  r2   Read-after-Write  
r5 <-  r3  op  r4   (RAW)

Anti dependence
r3 <-   r1  op  r2   Write-after-Read 
r1 <-   r4  op  r5   (WAR)

Output-dependence
r3 <-  r1  op  r2    Write-after-Write 
r5 <-  r3  op  r4    (WAW)
r3 <-  r6  op  r7

Flow dependences always need to be obeyed because they constitute true dependence on a register. Anti and output dependences exist due to limited number of architectural registers.

docs.title: Solution
docs.text:
• Anti and output dependences: write to the destination only in the last stage and in program order
  • Flow dependences:
    • Hardware pipeline stall: Detect and wait until value is available in register file
    • Software pipeline stall: Detect and eliminate the dependence at the software level
    • Data Forward/Bypass: Detect and forward/bypass data to dependent instruction

Hardware based:

Software based:

  • Compiler insert enough NOPs for the required result to be ready
  • Compiler orders the instructions, hardware executes them in that order
  • The compile doesn't know: Variable-length operation latency, memory addr, branch direction. The way to alleviate this: profiling(​性能​分析​)

Data Forward:

  • Forward to Execute stage from either Mem stage or WB stage
  • If both the Memory and Writeback stages contain matching destination registers?
    • The Memory stage should have priority, because it contains the more recently executed instruction.
  • cases when forwarding is not possible: The lw instruction does not finish reading data until the end of the Memory stage. its result cannot be forwarded to the Execute stage of the next instruction. Then we have to stall

docs.title: Control dependence
docs.text: • Data dependence on the Instruction Pointer / Program Counter

docs.title: Pipelined CPU: Ideal vs. Realistic
docs.text:
Ideal pipelined CPU has：

  • One pipeline
  • Fixed latency
  • Dependency is known at compiler time
  • no support for exception/interrupt

Realistic Pipelined CPU has:

  • Multiple pipelines with different latencies
  • Unpredictable latency
  • Unknown dependency at compiler time
  • Support for exception/interrupt

docs.title: Multi-Cycle Execution
docs.text:
Not all instructions take the same amount of time for “execution”

  • solution: Have multiple different functional units that take different number of cycles

  • Can let independent instructions start execution on a different functional unit before a previous long-latency instruction finishes execution
    • But this is wrong in a Von Neumann architecture: Sequential semantics of the ISA NOT preserved!

docs.title: Exception and Interrupt
docs.text:
“Unplanned” changes or interruptions in program execution

  • Exceptions: Due to internal problems in execution of the program
  • Interrupts: Due to external events that need to be handled by the processor

The architectural state should be consistent (precise) when the exception/interrupt is ready to be handled

  1. All previous instructions should be completely retired.
  2. No later instruction should be retired.

Retire

Retire = commit = finish execution and update arch state

Four Goals of Precise Exception:

  1. Keeps the semantics of the von Neumann model
  2. Aids software debugging
  3. Enables (easy) recovery from exceptions
  4. Enables traps into software (e.g., software implemented opcodes)

How to ensure precise exceptions in pipelining:

  • Idea: Make each operation take the same amount of time
    • but Worst-case instruction latency determines all instructions’ latency

docs.title: Reorder buffer(ROB)
docs.text:
• For false dependences(WAW, WAR)
  • For exception and interrupt
  • For multi-cycle execute

docs.title: Concepts
docs.text:
• Key Idea: Complete instructions out-of-order, but reorder them before writing results to architectural state (Commit)

  • When instruction is decoded in order, it servers the next sequential entry in the ROB, rename the destination register.

  • When instruction completes out-of-order, it writes result into ROB entry
  • When instruction oldest in ROB and it has completed without exceptions, its result writes to reg file or memory(in order commitment)

docs.title: Structure
docs.text:
ROB needs to:

  1. correctly reorder instructions back into the program order
  2. update the architectural state with the instruction’s result(s), if instruction can retire without any issues
  3. handle an exception/interrupt precisely, if an exception/interrupt needs to be handled before retiring the instruction
  4. use valid bits to keep track of readiness of the result(s) and find out if the instruction has completed execution
                            ┌────────────────────────────────────┐
                            │            Reorder Buffer           │
                            │  ┌──────────────────────────────┐   │
                            │  │  Entry0  │  Entry1  │ ...    │   │
                            │  ├──────────┼──────────┼────────┤   │
                            │  │ Valid    │ Valid    │ Valid  │   │
                            │  │ Ready    │ Ready    │ Ready  │   │
                            │  │ Type     │ Type     │ Type   │   │
                            │  │ Dest Reg │ Dest Reg │ Dest Reg│   │
                            │  │ Value    │ Value    │ Value  │   │
                            │  │ Exception│ Exception│ Exception│  │
                            │  │ PC       │ PC       │ PC     │   │
                            │  └──────────┴──────────┴────────┘   │
                            │      ▲                   ▲          │
                            │      │                   │          │
                            │    Head                Tail         │
                            │   (​提交​指针​)          (​分配​指针​)     │
                            └────────────────────────────────────┘
                                         │

docs.title: Independent Operations
docs.text:
Indirection:

  1. Result first written to ROB on instruction completion
  2. Result written to register file at commit time

Reorder Buffer Access:

  1. Access register file first (check if the register is valid)
    • If register not valid, register file stores the ID of the reorder buffer entry that contains (or will contain) the value of the register
    • Mapping of the register to a ROB entry: Register file maps the register to a reorder buffer entry if there is an in-flight instruction writing to the register
  2. Access reorder buffer next

docs.title: For false dependences
docs.text:
Output and anti dependences are not true dependences

  • The same register refers to values that have nothing to do with each other

  • They exist due to lack of register ID’s (i.e. names) in the ISA

  • RB eliminates anti and output dependences: Gives the illusion that there are a large number of registers

HOW: The register ID is renamed to the reorder buffer entry that will hold the register’s value

  • Register ID -> ROB entry ID
  • Architectural register ID -> Physical register ID
  • After renaming, ROB entry ID used to refer to the register
​例子​说明​ 
​假设​只有​ R1 ​一个​物理​寄存器​
ADD  R1, R2, R3  ; ​写​ R1
SUB  R4, R1, R5  ; ​读​ R1 (RAW ​真​相关​，​必须​等​)
MUL  R1, R6, R7  ; ​写​ R1 (WAW ​输出​相关​，​与​ ADD ​冲突​)

┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                   ​寄存器​映射​表​ (RAT)                     │
│  ​架构​寄存器​    →   ​物理​寄存器​ (ROB ​条目​索引​)               │
│  R1           →   ROB[5]  (​最新​映射​)                     │
│  R4           →   ROB[2]                                │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

​执行​流程​：
1. ADD:  ​分配​ ROB[5] → R1 ​映射​到​ ROB[5]，​执行​结果​写​ ROB[5]
2. SUB:  ​读​ R1 → ​查​ RAT ​得​ ROB[5] (​读该​位置​的​值​)
3. MUL:  ​分配​新​ ROB[9] → R1 ​映射​改为​ ROB[9]
        WAW ​消除​了​！ADD ​写​ ROB[5]，MUL ​写​ ROB[9]，​互不​冲突​

docs.title: Pipeline
docs.text: • In-order dispatch/execution, out-of-order completion, in-order retirement:

docs.title: Tradeoffs
docs.text:
Advantages:

  • Conceptually simple for supporting precise exceptions
  • Can eliminate false dependences

Disadvantages:

  • Reorder buffer needs to be accessed to get the results that are yet to be written to the register file
    • Indirection -> increased latency and complexity

docs.title: Superscalar
docs.text:
• Idea: Fetch, decode, execute, retire multiple instructions per cycle
    • N-wide superscalar->N instructions per cycle
  • Issues:
    • Need to add the hardware resources for doing so
    • Hardware performs the dependence checking between concurrently-fetched instructions

docs.title: In-order superscalar processor
docs.text:
• Idea: Multiple copies of data-path: Can fetch/decode/execute multiple instructions per cycle.
  • Issue: Dependences make it tricky to dispatch multiple instructions in the same cycle.
    • Need dependence detection between concurrently-fetched instructions.

Dependences

docs.title: Tradeoffs
docs.text:
Advantages

  • Higher instruction throughput: Higher IPC: instructions per cycle (lower CPI)

Disadvantages

  • Higher complexity for dependence checking
    • Require checking within a pipeline stage
    • Register renaming becomes more complex in an OoO processor
    • Potentially lengthens critical path delay  clock cycle time
  • More hardware resources needed

docs.title: Vector instruction
docs.text:
Flynn's Taxonomy of Computers

  • SISD: Single instruction operates on single data element
  • SIMD: Single instruction operates on multiple data elements
    • Array processor
    • Vector processor
  • MISD: Multiple instructions operate on single data element
    • Closest form: systolic array processor, streaming processor
  • MIMD: Multiple instructions operate on multiple data elements(multiple instruction streams)
    • Multiprocessor
    • Multithreaded processor

docs.title: SISD
docs.text:
• SISD computer that exploits no parallelism in either the instruction or data streams.
  • For example, traditional uniprocessor machines

docs.title: SIMD
docs.text:
• SIMD computer exploits multiple data streams against a single instruction stream to operations that are naturally parallelized.
  • Examples of SIMD:
    • Intel SIMD instruction extensions
    • AMD, PowerPC

What needs to be added to support SIMD instructions

  • Memory: multiple bank design
  • Registers: Vector register file

docs.title: MIMD
docs.text:
• MIMD computer exploits a number of processors that function asynchronously andindependently for parallelism.
  • At any time, different processors may be executing different instructions on different pieces of data.

docs.title: Idea1
docs.text:
Hardware has multiple thread contexts (PC+registers). Each cycle, fetch engine fetches from a different thread.

  • By the time the fetched branch/instruction resolves, no instruction is fetched from the same thread
  • Branch/instruction resolution latency overlapped with execution of other threads’ instructions

docs.title: Idea2
docs.text:
Switch to another thread every cycle such that no two instructions from a thread are in the pipeline concurrently.

Advantages:

  • Tolerates the control and data dependency latencies by overlapping the latency with useful work from other threads
  • Improves pipeline utilization by taking advantage of multiple threads

docs.title: Advantages and disadvatages
docs.text:
Advantages

  • No need for dependency checking between instructions (only one instruction in pipeline from a single thread)
  • No need for branch prediction logic
  • Otherwise-bubble cycles used for executing useful instructions from different threads
  • Improved system throughput, latency tolerance, utilization

Disadvantages

  • Extra hardware complexity: multiple hardware contexts (PCs, register files, …), thread selection logic
  • Reduced single thread performance (one instruction fetched every N cycles from the same thread)
  • Resource contention between threads in caches and memory
  • Some dependency checking logic between threads remains (load/store)

docs.title: Multi-core
docs.text:
Idea: Put multiple cores on the same die.

Technology scaling (Moore’s Law) enables more transistors to be placed on the same die area

What else could you do with the die area you dedicate to multiple processors?

  • Have a bigger, more powerful core
  • Have larger caches in the memory hierarchy
  • Simultaneous multithreading
  • Integrate platform components on chip (e.g., network interface, memory controllers)

docs.title: Why not more powerful single core?
docs.text:
• Very difficult to design (Scalable algorithms for improving single-thread performance elusive)
  • Power hungry – many out-of-order execution structures consume significant power/area when scaled. Why?
  • Diminishing returns on performance;
  • Does not significantly help memory-bound application performance (Scalable algorithms for this elusive).

docs.title: vs. Large Superscalar
docs.text:
Multi-core advantages

  • Simpler cores -> more power efficient, lower complexity, easier to design and replicate, higher frequency (shorter wires, smaller structures)
  • Higher system throughput on multiprogrammed workloads -> reduced context switches
  • Higher system throughput in parallel applications

Multi-core disadvantages

  • Requires parallel tasks/threads to improve performance (parallel programming)
  • Resource sharing can reduce single-thread performance
  • Shared hardware resources need to be managed
  • Number of pins limits data supply for increased demand

docs.title: Why Multi-Core over Large Superscalar
docs.text:
Technology push:

  • Instruction issue queue size limits the cycle time of the superscalar, OoO processor -> diminishing performance
    • Quadratic increase in complexity with issue width
  • Large, multi-ported register files to support large instruction windows and issue widths -> more resources, reduced frequency or longer RF access, 6diminishing performance

Application pull:

  • Multiple applications run on your CPU

docs.title: Problem with ROB
docs.text:
An In-order Pipeline with only ROB:

  • Dispatch: Act of sending an instruction to a functional unit
  • Renaming with ROB
    • eliminates stalls due to false dependences
  • Problem: A true data dependence stalls dispatch of younger instructions into functional (execution) units

  • ADD cannot dispatch because its source register R3 is unavailable
  • Later independent instructions cannot get executed

docs.title: Preventing Dispatch Stalls
docs.text:
• Problem: in-order dispatch (scheduling, or execution)

  • Solution: out-of-order dispatch (scheduling, or execution)

  • Goal of out-of-order dispatch:

    • Like Dataflow, “fire” an instruction only when its inputs are ready

docs.title: Reservation Station
docs.text:
• Key idea of reservation station: Move the dependent instructions out of the way of independent ones(s.t. independent ones can execute)
    • Rest areas for dependent instructions: Reservation Stations
  • Function of Reservation Station:
    • Monitors the source “values” of each instruction in the resting area
    • “Fires” (i.e. dispatch) the instruction, when all source “values” of an instruction are available
      • Instructions dispatched in dataflow (not control-flow) order
  • Benefit of Reservation Station:
    • Latency tolerance: Allows independent instructions to execute and complete in the presence of a long-latency operation

Inorder vs. Out-of-order Dispatch

Two humps in a modern pipeline:

  1. Reservation stations (enabling in-order issue and out-of-order dispatch/execution)
  2. Reorder buffer (enabling OoO completion, in-order commitment)

docs.title: Enabling OoO Execution
docs.text:
1. Need to link the consumer of a value to the producer
    • Register renaming: Associate a “tag” with each data value
  2. Need to buffer instructions until they are ready to execute
    • Insert instruction into reservation stations after renaming
  3. Instructions need to keep track of readiness of source values
    • Broadcast the “tag” when the value is produced
    • Instructions compare their “source tags” to the broadcast tag -> if match, source value becomes ready
  4. When all source values of an instruction are ready, need to dispatch the instruction to its functional unit (FU)
    • Instruction wakes up if all sources are ready
    • If multiple instructions are awake, need to select one per FU

docs.title: Register renaming
docs.text:
• The dest. register ID is renamed to the reservation station entry
    • Destination register ID -> RS entry ID
    • After renaming, RS entry ID used to refer to the register for the following instructions before updating the register.
  • This eliminates anti- and output- dependences
    • Approximates the performance effect of a large number of registers even though ISA has a small number.

docs.title: Tomasulo Algorithm
docs.text: • OoO with register renaming invented by Robert Tomasulo in 1967

docs.title: 1.ID
docs.text:
If reservation station entry available before renaming dest. register

  • Occupy a RS entry for the instruction
  • For each source register in the RS entry:
    • if the valid bit of source register in RF(Register File) is 1, RS.source.v = 1 and RS.source.value=source register;
    • else RS.source.v = 0 and RS.source.tag = source register.tag.
  • For dest. register in RF: Rename to the tag of the corresponding RS entry, set the valid bit to 0.

Else stall

docs.title: 2.RS
docs.text:
While in reservation station, each instruction:

  • Update: Watches common data bus (CDB) for tag of its sources. When tag seen, grab value for the source and keep it in the reservation station (.v = 1).
  • Issue: When both operands available, instruction ready to be dispatched to FU

docs.title: 3.EXE
docs.text: • Execute the instruction in FU, produce its broadcast tag and value

docs.title: 4.WB
docs.text:
After instruction finishes in the Functional Unit

  1. Arbitrate for CDB
  2. Put broadcast tag and its broadcast value onto CDB (tag broadcast)
  3. Update register file connected to the CDB
    • If the tag in the RF matches the broadcast tag, write broadcast value into register (and set valid bit)
  4. Update reservation station connected to the CDB If the broadcast tag matches the tag of any source in a RS entry, write the broadcast value to the source and set the valid bit of the source.

docs.title: Some Questions
docs.text:
• Can the algorithm above keep precise exception?
    • No, commitment is out of order
  • What can potentially become the critical path?
    • Tag broadcast -> value capture -> instruction wake up
  • How can you reduce the potential critical paths?
    • Break down the critical path

docs.title: Dataflow Graph
docs.text:
MUL   R3 <- R1, R2
ADD   R5 <- R3, R4
ADD   R7 <- R2, R6
ADD   R10 <- R8, R9
MUL   R11 <- R7, R10
ADD   R5 <- R5, R11

docs.title: Summary of OOO Execution Concepts
docs.text:
• Register renaming eliminates false dependences, enables linking of producer to consumers

  • Buffering in reservation stations enables the pipeline to move for independent instructions

  • Tag broadcast enables communication (of readiness of produced value) between instructions

  • Wakeup and select enables out-of-order dispatch

docs.title: Modern OoO Execution/ Precise Exceptions
docs.text:
Most modern processors use the following to achieve precise exception and OoO Exe

  • Reorder buffer to support in-order retirement of instructions
  • A single register file to store all registers
    • Both speculative and architectural registers
    • INT and FP are still separate
  • Two register maps
    • Future/frontend register map -> used for renaming
    • Architectural register map -> used for maintaining precise state

docs.title: OoO Execution with Precise Execution
docs.text:
• Idea: Use a reorder buffer to reorder instructions before committing them to architectural state
  • An instruction updates the RAT when it completes execution
    • Also called frontend register file
  • An instruction updates a separate architectural register file when it retires
    • i.e., when it is the oldest in the machine and has completed execution
    • In other words, the architectural register file is always updated in program order
  • On an exception: flush pipeline, copy architectural register file into frontend register file

docs.title: OoO Execution: Restricted Dataflow
docs.text:
• An out-of-order engine dynamically builds the dataflow graph of a piece of the program
    • which piece?

  • The dataflow graph is limited to the instruction window

    • Instruction window: all decoded but not yet retired instructions

  • Can we do it for the whole program?

  • Why would we like to?
  • In other words, how can we have a large instruction window?
  • Can we do it efficiently with Tomasulo’s algorithm?

docs.title: Questions to Ponder
docs.text:
Why is OoO execution beneficial?

  • What if all operations take a single cycle?
  • Latency tolerance: OoO execution tolerates the latency of multi-cycle operations by executing independent operations concurrently

What if an instruction takes 1000 cycles?

  • How large of an instruction window do we need to continue decoding?
  • How many cycles of latency can OoO tolerate?
  • What limits the latency tolerance scalability of Tomasulo’s algorithm?
    • Instruction window size: how many decoded but not yet retired instructions you can keep in the machine.

docs.title: Approaches to Dependence Detection
docs.text:
Scoreboarding:

  • Each register in register file has a Valid bit associated with it
  • An instruction that is writing to the register resets the Valid bit

  • An instruction in Decode stage checks if all its source and destination registers are Valid

    • Yes: No need to stall… No dependence
    • No: Stall the instruction

  • Advantage: simple, 1 bit per register

  • Disadvantage: Need to stall for all types of dependences, not only flow dependence

docs.title: 📐 ​左栏​ (Column 1)
docs.text:
1. ​为何​要​ Cache - DRAM ​延迟​ ~100ns。 - CPU ​周期​ ~1ns。 - ​硬件​自动​管理​ (​透明​)。 - ​程序员​无需​关心​正确性​。 - ​关心​则​为了​速度​。

2. ​局部性​原理​ (​关键​) - ​时间​局部性​：​刚​访问​，​再​访问​。 - ​例子​：​循环​变量​。 - ​空间​局部性​：​邻近​地址​，​将​访问​。 - ​例子​：​数组​遍历​、​顺序​指令​。

3. ​核心​计算公式​ - ​命中率​ = ​命中​数​ / ​总​访问​。 - ​失效率​ = 1 - ​命中率​。 - AMAT = (​命中率​×​命中​延迟​) + (​失效率​×​失效​延迟​)。 - ​层次​延迟​公式​： - \(T_i = t_i + mr_i × T_{i+1}\)。 - ​目标​：​压低​ \(mr_i\) ​与​ \(T_{i+1}\)。

4. ​三种​映射​方式​ - ​直接​映射​： - ​位置​：​只能​放​固定​行​。 - ​优点​：​简单​，​快​。 - ​缺点​：​冲突​缺失​严重​。 - ​全​相联​： - ​位置​：​可​放​任意​行​。 - ​优点​：​无​冲突​缺失​。 - ​缺点​：​比较​器极​多​，​仅限​小​容量​。 - ​组​相联​ (N​路​)： - ​位置​：​放​特定​组内​ N ​行​。 - ​结论​：​最佳​权衡​。

5. Cache ​寻址​结构​ - ​地址​拆分​：Tag | Index | Offset。 - Index：​定位​行​/​组​。 - Tag：​比​对​确认​命中​。 - Valid Bit：​标记​数据​有效​。 - ​查找​流程​：​发​地址​ -> ​查​ Index -> ​比​ Tag -> ​验​ Valid -> ​送​数据​。

docs.title: 📐 ​右栏​ (Column 2)
docs.text:
6. ​相联​度​权衡​ (​高频​) - ​高​相联​度​： - ✅ ​冲突​少​，​命中​高​。 - ❌ ​延迟​变​大​，​比较​器多​。 - ​收益​递减​规律​： - 2-way ​提升​大​。 - 8-way ​到​ 16-way ​增益​小​。

7. ​延迟​与​存储​对比​ - ​存储​三角​： - SRAM：​快​、​贵​、​小​。 - DRAM：​中​、​中​、​大​。 - Flash/​磁盘​：​慢​、​便宜​、​超大​。 - ​能耗​痛点​： - DRAM ​访存​能耗​ ≈ ​整数​加法​的​ 6400​倍​。

8. GPU ​与​ ​加速器​ - GPU ​用​ Shared Memory (​手动​管理​)。 - GPU ​用​ FGMT (​线程​切换​) ​隐藏​延迟​。 - ​大规模​ Cache ​在​ GPU ​中​不​占​主导​。 - ML ​加速器​多用​ Scratchpad (​手动​)。

9. Roofline ​模型​ - ​算术​强度​ = FLOPs / Bytes。 - Cache：​提供​大​带宽​。 - DRAM：​提供​小​带宽​。 - ​高强度​程序​：​受限于​计算​ (Cache​内​)。 - ​低​强度​程序​：​受限于​内存​带宽​ (​频繁​访存​)。

10. ​易错​与​细节​ - ​冲突​缺失​：​仅​存在​于​直接​映射​和​组​相联​。 - ​交替​访问​ A,B (​同组​)：​导致​全​ Miss。 - ​块​大小​： - ​太小​：​未​用​空间​局部性​。 - ​太​大​：​填充​慢​，​污染​ Cache。

docs.title: 📐 ​左栏​ (Column 1)
docs.text:
11. ​替换​策略​ (Replacement) - ​缺块​时选​Victim。 - ​先找​无效​块​ (Invalid)。 - ​全​有效​则​查​策略​。 - LRU：​淘汰​最久​未用​。 - 2​路​LRU：​需​1​位​记录​。 - 4​路​LRU：​需​6​位​(​硬​)。 - ​真​LRU​硬件​复杂​。 - ​现代​CPU​用伪​LRU (PLRU)。 - 8​路​PLRU​用​7​位树​。 - ​随机​替换​ (Random)： - ​避免​集​抖动​ (Thrashing)。 - ​循环​访问​ A,B,C,D,E： - 4​路​LRU​命中率​ 0%。 - LRU​与​随机​命中率​相近​。

12. ​最优​理论​ (Belady's OPT) - ​淘汰​未来​最远​才​用​的​块​。 - ​理论​最优​，​无法​实现​。

13. ​写​策略​ (Write Policy) - ​写​分配​ (Write-Allocate)： - Miss​时​先读​块​进​Cache。 - ​再​修改​ (​默认​)。 - ​写​不​分配​ (Write-No-Allocate)： - Miss​时直​写​内存​。 - ​不进​Cache (I/O​用​)。 - ​写回​ (Write-Back)： - ​只​写​Cache。 - Evict​时写​回​内存​。 - ​需脏位​ (Dirty Bit)。 - ​省​带宽​、​省​能耗​。 - ​写​直达​ (Write-Through)： - ​同时​写​Cache​和​内存​。 - ​一致性​简单​。 - Evict​无需​写回​。 - ​带宽​消耗​大​。

14. ​指令​/​数据​分离​ - L1​几乎​分离​ (Split)。 - L2/L3​几乎​统一​ (Unified)。 - ​统一​缓存​优点​：​动态​共享​空间​。 - ​缺点​：​指令和数据​互相​污染​。

15. ​三类​Cache Miss (3C) - ​强制​缺失​ (Compulsory)： - ​首次​访问​，​不可避免​。 - ​预取​ (Prefetch) ​可​缓解​。 - ​容量​缺失​ (Capacity)： - ​工作​集​ > Cache​大小​。 - ​全​相联​下​仍​存在​。 - ​冲突​缺失​ (Conflict)： - ​映射​到​同​一组​导致​。 - ​提高​相联​度​可​缓解​。

16. Cache​关键​参数​ - ​容量​ (C)：​数据​总​字节​。 - ​块​大小​ (b)：​每块​字节数​。 - ​块数​ (B) = C / b。 - ​相联​度​ (N)：​每​组块​数​。 - ​组数​ (S) = B / N。 - ​容量​太​大​→​延迟​变​长​。 - ​块​太小​→​未​用​空间​局部性​。 - ​块​太大​→​污染​+​块​数少​。 - ​高​相联​度​→​命中​高​但​延迟​长​。 - ​收益​递减​：2​路​提升​大​，16​路​增益​小​。

docs.title: 📐 ​右栏​ (Column 2)
docs.text:
17. ​多核​Cache​设计​ - ​多核​共享内存​带宽​。 - ​两种​组织​： - ​私有​ (Private)： - ​快​，​紧贴​核​。 - ​数据​冗余​，​利用率​低​。 - ​共享​ (Shared)： - ​大容量​，​动态分配​。 - ​无​碎片​，​一致性​易​维护​。 - ​缺点​：​访问​慢​，​核间​冲突​。 - ​无​性能​隔离​ (​干扰​严重​)。

18. ​一致性​ vs. ​一致性​ - Coherence (​连贯性​)： - ​针对​同一​地址​。 - ​写​操作​全局​串行化​。 - Consistency (​一致性​)： - ​针对​所有​地址​。 - ​全局​内存​访问​顺序​。

19. ​一致性​三大​要求​ - ​程序​序​：​同核​写​后​读​得​新值​。 - ​全局​视图​：​写​传播​可见​。 - ​写​串行化​：​多核​写​顺序​一致​。

20. ​监听​协议​ (Snooping) - ​基于​总线​ (Bus)。 - ​广播​所有​请求​。 - ​总线​是​单点​串行化​。 - ​优点​：​实现​简单​。 - ​缺点​：​不​扩展​ (​广播​瓶颈​)。

21. ​目录​协议​ (Directory) - ​基于​交换​网络​ (Switch)。 - ​目录​跟踪​每块​共享​者​。 - ​每个​块​有​独立​串行​点​。 - ​优点​：​可​扩展​。 - ​缺点​：​查询​延迟​长​。

22. ​更新​ vs. ​失效​ - ​更新​ (Update)： - ​写时​广播​新​数据​。 - ​适合​频繁​读​共享​。 - ​失效​ (Invalidate)： - ​写​时令​其它​副本​无效​。 - ​适合​写后​无​读取​。 - ​高​竞争​导致​"​乒乓​"​效应​。

23. MSI ​状态机​ (​考点​) - M (Modified)： - ​独占​，​脏​，​可​读写​。 - S (Shared)： - ​多核​共享​，​干净​。 - I (Invalid)： - ​无效​/​不​存在​。

24. MESI ​协议​ (​核心​) - ​在​MSI​基础​上加​ E (Exclusive)。 - E (Exclusive)： - ​独占​，​干净​。 - ​本地​读​/​写​无需​总线​事务​。 - ​减少​了​不必要​的​总线​失效​。 - Intel​用​ MESIF (F=Forward)。 - AMD​用​ MOESI (O=Owned)。

25. MESI ​状态​转换​ (​高频​) - ​本地​读​： - I→S/E (​看​总线​)。 - E→E (Hit)。 - S→S (Hit)。 - M→M (Hit)。 - ​本地​写​： - I→M (​发​总线​写​)。 - E→M (​无​总线​动作​!)。 - S→M (​发​总线​失效​)。 - M→M (​无​总线​动作​)。 - ​远程​读​嗅​探​： - M→S (​写回​内存​)。 - E→S (​降级​共享​)。 - S→S (​保持​)。 - ​远程​写​嗅​探​： - M/E/S→I (​全部​失效​)。

26. ​目录​存储​开销​ - ​每块​需​ N + log₂N + 2 ​位​。 - 2​位​状态​ + N​位​共享​向量​ + log₂N​位​Owner​指针​。

27. ​目录​基本操作​ - GetS：​读​请求​。 - GetEx：​写​/​独占​请求​。 - ​目录​负责​发送​失效​消息​。 - ​目录​更新​共享​向量​。 - Owner​负责​写​回脏​数据​。

docs.title: 1. ​通用​性能​公式
docs.text:
Execution time：​单指令​ CPI × clock cycle time；​程序​ T = IC × CPI_avg × T_clk。​多​周期​ CPU：CPI_avg = Σ f_i × cycles_i。​若有​ cache miss：T = T_base + (#memory accesses) × miss rate × miss penalty。

Amdahl ​定律​：​若​可​并行​比例​为​ f，​处理器​数​ N，Speedup = 1 / ((1-f)+f/N)；​上限​ 1/(1-f)。​并行​部分​不是​免费​：​同步​、​负载​不均​、​资源​争用​都​会​降低​收益​。

Little ​定律​：L = λW。​硬件​里常写​：concurrency/buffer size = throughput × latency。​例​：12GB/s、100ns → ​约​ 1200B? ​注意​单位​：12×10^9 B/s ×100×10^-9s=1200B

Roofline：AI = total OPs(or FLOPs) / memory bytes；attainable throughput = min(peak compute, AI × peak bandwidth)。​拐点​/ridge point：AI* = peak compute / peak bandwidth。AI < AI* memory-bound；AI > AI* compute-bound。​优化​判断​：​实测​点​接近​ roofline → ​已​接近​充分​优化​；​离​ roofline ​很​远​ → ​算子​实现​、​并行度​、​访存​、​向​量化​仍​有​问题​。

AMAT：AMAT = hit time + miss rate × miss penalty。​若​题目​说​ miss access time ​已​包含​ hit time，​则​用​ hit_rate×hit_time + miss_rate×miss_time；​没​说明​通常​按​前者​。

docs.title: 2. Von Neumann / ​单​周期​ / ​多​周期​ / ​流水线
docs.text:
Von Neumann ​两点​：stored program（​指令和数据​存于​统一​线性​内存​）；sequential instruction processing（in-order commitment）。

Single-cycle：CPI=1，​但​ T_clk ​由​最慢​指令​决定​。​没有​程序员​不​可见​中间状态​。

Multi-cycle：​把​指令​分成​若干​状态​，​一条​指令​多​周期​，T_clk ​变短​；​不同​指令​周期​数​不同​。ISA ​只​规定​ AS→AS'，​微结构​可​加入​不​可见​状态​ MS。

Pipeline：​把​指令​处理​分为​ IF/ID/EX/MEM/WB ​等​阶段​，​不同​指令​占​不同​阶段​。​稳态​理想​ CPI≈1，​提升​ throughput ​而​非​单条​ latency。​总​周期​粗略​：k + n - 1 + stalls（k ​为​阶段​数​）。

Hazard：​结构​冒险​（​硬件资源​冲突​）、​数据​冒险​、​控制​冒险​。​数据​依赖​：RAW ​真​依赖​必须​遵守​；WAR/WAW ​是​名称​依赖​，​可用​ renaming ​消除​。Forwarding/bypass ​可​减少​ RAW stall；load-use ​常​仍​需​等待​；branch ​需要​预测​/flush。

docs.title: 3. ​数据​依赖​与​寄存器​重命名
docs.text:
WAR/WAW ​本质​是​ architectural register ​名字​不够​，​不是​值​依赖​。

Renaming ​核心​：​把​ architectural register ​映射​到​ physical register / ROB entry / RS tag。​后续​消费者​不再​看​“R3”，​而是​看​“​产生​当前​ R3 ​新值​的​ tag”。​这样​同名​但​无关​的​值​被​拆开​。

docs.title: 4. ROB（Reorder Buffer）
docs.text:
​目的​：out-of-order complete，​但​ in-order commit，​保证​ precise exception。​异常​发生​时​，​已​ commit ​的​都​是​老​指令​，​新​指令​可​ flush。

ROB ​流程​： 1. in-order Decode/rename ​按程序​顺序​分配​ ROB entry，​目的​寄存器​ rename ​到​该​ entry。 2. OoO Execute: ​可​乱序​完成​，​结果​先写​ ROB，​不​直接​写​ architectural state。 3. In-order Commit ​只​检查​ ROB head。​若​ head ready ​且​无​异常​，​写回​寄存器​/​内存​；​若​异常​，flush ​后​跳​异常​处理​。

ROB ​可存​字​段​：busy/valid、dest architectural reg、value、ready、exception、PC/order。Load/store ​常​还​需​地址​/​数据​/​是否​可​提交​。

​为什么​ precise exception ​需要​ in-order commit：​如果​新​指令​先​把​结果​写入​寄存器​/​内存​，​老​指令​再​异常​，​体系结构​状态​无法​恢复​到​“​异常​指令​之前​”​的​顺序​状态​。

docs.title: 5. Tomasula：​三大​结构​与​时间​点​（​重点​）
docs.text:
Why OoO？

  • In-order ​里​，​一条​长​延迟​指令​会​把​后面​的​独立​指令​也​挡住​。
  • OoO ​让​“​数据​已​就绪​”​的​指令​先​执行​，​提升​吞吐​。

Tomasulo ​三​组件​：Register Rename/Alias Table，Reservation Station，Common Data Bus(CDB)。​现代​处理器​常再加​ ROB ​以​保证​ precise exception。

docs.title: 5.1 Register Renaming Table / RF ​表
docs.text:
​表项​：Valid/V、Tag、Value。V=0​寄存器​的​新值​尚未​产生​，Tag ​指向​将​产生​它​的​ RS entry ​或​ ROB/physical reg。

ID/rename ​时​更新​： 1. ​若​有空​ RS，​指令​占用​一个​ RS entry，​记该​ entry ​的​ tag。 2. ​对​每个​源​寄存器​：​若​ RF/RAT ​中​ V=1，​把​ value ​复制到​ RS.source.value ​并设​ source.V=1；​若​ V=0，​把​ producer tag ​复制到​ RS.source.tag ​并设​ source.V=0。 3. ​对​目的​寄存器​：RF/RAT[dest].tag = ​当前​ RS tag，V=0。​这​一步​就是​ register renaming，​可​消除​之后​指令​看到​的​ WAR/WAW。 4. ​若无空​ RS，​则​ issue/rename stall。

CDB/WB ​时​更新​：​执行​完成​后​，FU ​申请​ CDB，​广播​ (tag,value)。​所有​ RS ​监听​：​若​某​ source.tag ​匹配​广播​ tag，​则​写入​ value ​并​把​ source.V ​置​ 1。RF/RAT ​也​监听​：​只有​当​ RF/RAT[reg].tag ​仍​等于​广播​ tag，​才​写​ value ​并​置​ V=1；​若​ tag ​不​匹配​，​说明​该​ architectural reg ​已​被​更新​指令​重新​ rename，​不能​覆盖​。

docs.title: 5.2 Reservation Station（RS）
docs.text:
RS ​是​等待​区​/​调度​窗口​。​常见字​段​：Busy/Valid、Op、DestTag、src1/src2: V/Tag/Value​可能​还有​ immediate、​地址​、ROB id。

RS ​的​意义​：​把​等待​操作数​的​指令​从​流水线​前端​移开​，​让​无关​指令​继续​进入​；​每条​指令​在​ RS ​中等​自己​的​源​ tag/value。​所有​源​ V=1 ​且​ FU ​可用​时​ wakeup/select/dispatch。​执行​顺序​按​ dataflow，​不​按​原程序​顺序​。

RS ​更新​规则​： - ​插入​时​填​操作码​、​目的​ tag、​两个​源​的​ value/tag。 - ​等待​时​监听​ CDB，​匹配​ tag ​就​抓值​。 - ready ​后​发送到​功能​部件​；​执行​完成​并​广播​后​，RS entry ​释放​。

docs.title: 5.3 CDB（Common Data Bus）
docs.text: ​广播​完成​结果​ (tag,value)；​一个​周期​通常​只能​广播​有限​个​结果​，​所以​可能​发生​ CDB arbitration。CDB ​同时​唤醒​消费者​和​更新​ RF/RAT。

docs.title: 6. Tomasula/OOO ​题​模板
docs.text:
​常见​答案​句​：WAW hazard ​例​：I2 ​和​ I4 ​都​写​ $s4。​解决​：register renaming，​把​两个​ $s4 ​的​不同​版本​映射​到​不同​ ROB/RS/physical tag，commit ​时​保持​程序​顺序​。

​填表​小心​：fully pipelined FU ​表示​可​每​周期​启动​新​操作​，​但​ latency ​多​周期​；non-pipelined ​才​必须​等​整条​操作​结束​。in-order commit/precise exception ​表示​新​指令​即使​早​完成​，​也​只能​在​所有​更​老​指令​ commit ​后​ W。

​关键​性能​限制​:

  • ​指令​窗口​ = RS ​中未​发射​ + ROB ​中未​提交​的​指令​总数​。​越大​，​可​发现​的​并行性​越高​，​但​硬件​（CAM、​仲裁​）​开销​剧增​。
  • ​延迟​容忍度​：​由​窗口​大小​决定​；​若​一条​长​延迟​指令​，​需​巨大​窗口​才能​继续​填充​独立​指令​。

docs.title: 7. Superscalar / SIMD / Multi-core
docs.text:
Superscalar：​一​周期​ fetch/decode/issue ​多条​指令​，​需要​同​周期​依赖​检测​和​多个​功能​部件​。issue width ​越大​，issue queue、multi-port RF、bypass ​网络​复杂度​快速​上升​，​收益​递减​。​多核​优于​超大​单核​：​应用​可​并行​、​多​程序​负载​多​，​单核​ ILP ​有限​。

Flynn ​分类​：SISD；SIMD（vector/array）；MISD ​少见​，​近似​ systolic/streaming；MIMD ​多指令​多​数据​（​多核​、​多线程​）。

SIMD vs SIMT：SIMD ​由​程序​显式​写​向量​宽度​；SIMT ​用​线程​编程​，​硬件​把​一组​线程​组成​ warp，warp ​内​执行​同一​指令​。GPU ​本质​是​用​ SPMD ​编程​模型​跑​在​ SIMD/SIMT ​硬件​上​。

Fine-grained Multithreading: ​每​周期​切换​到​另​一个​线程​，​以​确保​同一​线程​中​的​两条​指令​不会​同时​进入​指令​流水线​。​无需​指令​间​依赖​检测​、​分支​预测​，​提高​吞吐量​；​但​硬件​开销​大​（​多套​线程​上下文​），​单线程​性能​下降​

docs.title: 8. GPU ​架构​与​优化
docs.text:
CUDA ​映射​：Grid → (Thread)Blocks → Threads；​硬件​：GPU → SM → CUDA cores/SIMT lanes；warp ​通常​ 32 consecutive threads，​是​基本​调度​单位​。​一个​ thread block ​可​被​调度​到​一个​ SM；block ​间​顺序​不​保证​。

  • SPMD（​编程​模型​）：​程序员​编写​一份​源代码​，​运行​在​多个​处理单元​上​，​处理​不同​的​数据​（​如​CUDA Kernel）。
  • SIMD（​硬件​指令​级​并行​）：​一条​指令​直接​控制​多个​数据通道​（​如​CPU​的​AVX​指令​）。
  • SIMT（​硬件​架构​模型​）：​是​SPMD​编程​模型​在​SIMD​硬件​上​的​具体​实现​。​将​大量​标量​线程​动态​捆绑​为​固定​大小​的​“​线程​束​（Warp）”，​将​Warp​内​的​线程​一一​映射​到​SIMD​通道​上​。
  • ​本质​关系​：SIMT​牺牲​了​SIMD“​全速​无​分支​”​的​极致​效率​，​换取​了​类似​SPMD“​易于​编程​、​处理​复杂​分支​”​的​灵活性​，​是​一种​权衡​产物​。

​如何​优化​global mem access: multithreading, memory coalescing, shared memory

Latency hiding：GPU ​用​ fine-grained multithreading(FGMT) ​在​ long-latency memory ​时​切换​ warp。Occupancy = active warps / max warps。occupancy ​太低​无法​隐藏​延迟​；​太高​也​可能​受​寄存器​/shared memory ​限制​而​不​一定​更​快​。

Memory coalescing：​同一​ warp ​连续​线程​访问​连续​/​对齐​地址​ → ​合并​为​少数​ memory transaction；stride/​随机​访问​导致​ transaction ​多​，​带宽​浪费​。

Shared memory / tiling：​把​全局​内存​ tile ​搬​到​ shared memory，__syncthreads() ​后​复用​，​减少​ DRAM ​访问​。​矩阵​乘​典型​：​加载​ A_tile/B_tile，​每个​线程​算​一个​/​多个​ C ​元素​。​注意​ bank conflict：​多个​线程​访问​同一​ bank ​不同​地址​会​串行​；padding ​可​缓解​。

GPU ​优化​关键词​：coalesced global load/store；shared-memory tiling；​减少​ divergence；​提高​ arithmetic intensity；​减少​ register spilling；​合适​ block size；​使用​ warp-level primitive；​避免​非​合并​原子​/​随机​访存​。

docs.title: 9. ​存储​层次​与​存储技术
docs.text:
​理想​内存​：​零​延迟​、​无限​容量​、​无限​带宽​、​零​成本​，​但​现实​中​ bigger/slower、faster/expensive、bandwidth/ports/banks expensive。

​层次​：​寄存器​/FF ​最快​最​贵​；SRAM ​用于​ cache/shared memory/global buffer；DRAM/HBM ​容量​大​但​延迟​高​；SSD/disk ​更慢​更​便宜​。SRAM ​适合​片上​缓冲​，DRAM ​优化​更​多​面向​容量​/​带宽​而​非​延迟​。

DRAM​子系统​：Channel->DIMM->Rank->Chip-Bank->Row/Column; DRAM​由于​capacitor​漏点​需​refresh，​有​耗能​，​降低​性能​和​QoS

DRAM row buffer：​顺序​访问​ row-buffer hit ​多​，​吞吐​高​；​随机​访问​ row-buffer miss ​多​，ACTIVATE/PRECHARGE ​开销​大​，​吞吐​差​。

docs.title: 10. Cache ​基础
docs.text:
​局部性​原理​：temporal locality：​最近​访问​很快​再​访问​；spatial locality：​相邻​地址​很快​被​访问​。Cache ​自动​利用​局部性​；accelerator ​常用​ software-managed buffer/scratchpad ​利用​固定​模式​。

​地址​分解​：[tag | index | block offset]。offset bits = log2(block size)；#blocks B = capacity C / block size b；#sets S = B / associativity N；index bits = log2(S)；tag bits = address bits - index - offset。

​访问​步骤​：​用​ index ​读​ tag/data store；​检查​ valid；​比较​ tag；hit ​则​返回​；miss ​则​按​替换​策略​选​ victim，​把​ memory block ​调入​，​必要​时写​回​ dirty victim。

​组织​：direct-mapped：N=1,S=B，​简单​快​但​ conflict ​多​。fully associative：N=B,S=1，​冲突​少​但​比较​器多​。N-way set associative：1<N<B,S=B/N，​折中​。

Replacement：invalid first；​否则​ Random/FIFO/LRU/PLRU/Hybrid。LRU ​不总优​：4-way cache ​循环​访问​ A,B,C,D,E ​会​ 0% hit（set thrashing），Random ​可能​更好​。

Block size ​取舍​：​太小​利用​不了​空间​局部性​、tag overhead ​大​；​太​大​ block ​数​减少​、​可能​浪费​带宽​和​容量​、​时间​局部性​下降​。

​多级​缓存​： - ​一级​缓存​追求​低​延迟​，​容量​小​、​低​相联​度​，tag ​与​数据​并行​读取​，​设计​受​时钟​周期​限制​； - ​二级缓存​侧重​均衡​命中率​，​大容量​高​相联​度​，​延迟​次要​，tag ​与​数据​可​串行​读取​； - ​多级​串行​访问​模式​下​一级​缓存​过滤​大部分​访存​，​两级​缓存​访问​流量​、​管理策略​均​不​相同​。

docs.title: 11. Cache miss ​分类​与​降低​方法
docs.text:
• Compulsory/cold miss：​第一次​访问​该​ block，​任何​ cache ​都​ miss；​可用​ prefetch ​缓解​。
  • Capacity miss：​即使​ fully associative ​且​同​容量​最优​替换​仍会​ miss，​因为​工作​集​大于​ cache。
  • Conflict miss：​不是​ compulsory，​也​不是​ capacity，​由​映射​冲突​导致​；​增加​ associativity、victim cache、​更好​ indexing、​随机化​、​软件​布局​可​缓解​。

docs.title: 12. Cache ​写​策略
docs.text:
1. write miss ​时​：write-allocate（​默认​，​先​把​整行​读入​ cache ​再​写​）​或​ write-no-allocate（​常用​于​ IO/streaming，​直接​写​内存​，​不​污染​ cache）。

  2. write hit​后​：write-back（​默认​，​只​写​ cache，evict dirty ​时写​内存​）​或​ write-through（cache ​和​内存​同时​写​）。

  3. Write-back：​省​带宽​、​合并​多次​写​；​需要​ dirty bit，​一致性​复杂​

  4. Write-through：​简单​、​下层​始终​新​、evict ​不写​回​；​但​带宽​开销​大​。
  5. I-cache/D-cache：L1 ​常​ split（I/D ​各自​低​延迟​、​避免​结构冲突​）；​更​高层​常​ unified（​空间​动态​共享​）。

docs.title: 13. Cache Coherence（​一致性​）
docs.text:
Coherence vs Consistency：coherence ​关注​同一​ memory location/cache block ​的​多​核​访问​顺序​，​是​局部​顺序​；consistency ​关注​不同​处理器​对​所有​ memory operations ​的​全局​可见​顺序​，​是​程序员​-​微结构​契约​。

​硬件​组成​：cores + private caches + interconnect + memory。Interconnect：snoop/bus ​或​ directory。​更新​策略​：invalidate ​或​ update。

Snooping/bus：​所有​ cache ​监听​总线​命令​，​适合​小规模​；​一次​一个​事务​，​可​广播​ invalidation/read miss。

Directory：​每个​ block ​有​ home node ​维护​目录​；local node ​发​请求​，home node ​转发给​ remote/sharer/owner。​可​扩展​到​ many-core，​避免​全局​广播​。

Directory ​字​段​：state bits；owner id（log2N bits，​拥有​唯一​ dirty/modified copy ​的​ cache）；sharer list（N-bit one-hot，​记录​哪些​ core/cache ​有​该​ block ​的​副本​）。

docs.title: 14. MSI / MESI ​状态​协议
docs.text:
MSI：I invalid：​本​ cache ​无该​ block；S shared：​一个​或​多个​ cache ​有​ clean copy，​只读​；M modified：​唯一​ dirty copy，​可​本地​读写​，​内存​旧​。Read miss ​取数​；write ​需要​ invalidate ​其他​副本​；M ​被​别人​读时​需​提供​/​写​回​并​转​ S。

MESI ​在​ MSI ​上加​ E exclusive：​唯一​ clean copy。E ​状态​本地​读​/​写​无需​ bus；​本地​写​ E→M ​不发​ invalidate。​远端​读​ E→S；​远端​写​ E→I。

docs.title: 15. Memory Consistency / Barrier
docs.text:
Ordering：​硬件​为了​性能​会​乱序执行​/​提交​/​可见​，​但​程序员​需要​某种​“​约定​顺序​”。​越强​的​ consistency model ​越​容易​编程​、​越难​高性能​。

​四类​ barrier：Load-Load/Load-Store/Store-Store/Store-Load(​最​昂贵​)：​前序​访存​操作​不可​重排​至​后序​访存​操作​之后​

​模型​对比​：Sequential Consistency ​最强​，​四种​ barrier ​都​保证​；TSO(Total Store Order)（x86/64）​通常​允许​ Store-Load ​重排​；PSO(ARM) ​更弱​；​更弱​模型​性能​更​高​但​程序员​需显式​ fence/atomic。

docs.title: 16. AI ​加速器​动机​与​原则
docs.text:
DNN ​特性​：Conv/FC/Attention ​主要​是​矩阵​乘​/MAC，​计算​量​占​比​很​高​；​访存​模式​较​固定​（Activation/FC: Burst; Conv/Pooling/Attention: Burst+Stride）；DRAM ​访问​能耗​远高于​ multiply。​目标​：​提高​ throughput、​降低​能耗​（​减少​内存​、buffer​访问​），​可​牺牲​通用性​。

DSA ​五​原则​： 1. Global Buffer/Scratchpad：​用​专用​片上​存储​减少​搬运​距离​，​替代​复杂​ cache。 2. ​简化​控制​：​省掉​复杂​ OoO/​预测​/​大​ cache，​把​面积​给​计算​阵列​和​片​上​存储​。 3. ​并行计算​模块​：​直接​支持​矩阵​/​向​量级​操作​。 4. ​量化​：FP16/BF16/INT8 ​等​降低​计算​与​带宽​。 5. ​专用​编程语言​/​编译器​/runtime：​让​软件​显式​管理​数据​搬运​和​调度​。

CPU vs DSA：CPU：cache、superscalar、inter-instruction parallelism、full functionality、​低​延迟​、general language。DSA：global buffer、in-order/simple、intra-instruction parallelism、partial functionality、​高​吞吐​、domain-specific language。

Cache vs Buffer:buffer​能耗​低​，​面积​小​，​手动​管理​

AI​加速器​集中​在​推理​而​非​训练​：AI​训练​内存​带宽​往往​是​整体​性能​的​瓶颈​，AI​加速器​不能​明显​地​提高​内存​带宽​的​利用效率​。​由于​推理​加速器​能​把​模型​存​到​AI​芯片​上​，​可​提高​10+​倍​能耗​比​；​训练​加速器​不能​把​模型​和​中间​结果​都​存到​芯片​上​

docs.title: 17. ​矩阵​乘​单元​ / Systolic Array / TPU
docs.text:
C=A×B。Scalar: 16^3=4096 ​次​；Vector ​可​并行​一个​维度​；Matrix unit ​一条​指令​/​一拍​完成​ tile ​乘​，​算力​密度​高​但​灵活性​低​。

Systolic array：​二维​ PE ​阵列​，​数据​有​节奏​地​在​阵列​中​流动​。PE ​更新​：Right = Left，Down = Upper，Cell += Upper × Left。​优势​：​权重​/​激活​/partial sum ​在​片​上​复用​，​减少​ global buffer/DRAM ​访问​。​周期​数​T=3N-2，N​为​方阵​宽​

TPU v1：​核心​是​ 256×256 MAC systolic array + Unified Buffer；​推理​场景​，​模型​可​预存​ DDR，​输入​经​ PCIe ​来​。

docs.title: 18. Ascend / DaVinci AICore
docs.text:
Cube ​模块​（​算力​担当​）：​矩阵​乘​单元​。FP16：​一拍​做​ 16×16 ​与​ 16×16 ​矩阵​乘​；INT8：16×32 ​与​ 32×16。Accumulator ​做​ C=A×B+C，​支持​卷积​ bias/​累加​。L0A/L0B/L0C ​分别​存​左​矩阵​、​右​矩阵​、​结果​/​中间​结果​；A/B DFF ​和​ Accum DFF ​缓存​当前​ tile。

Vector ​模块​（​多面手​）：​支持​ FP16/FP32 ​等​向量​运算​，​连续​/​固定​间隔​/VA ​不规则​寻址​。UB ​保存​源​/​目的​操作数​，​一般​ 32B ​对齐​。L0C→UB ​搬运​可经​ Vector Unit ​做​ ReLU/​格式​转换​。

Scalar ​模块​（​司令部​）：​像​小​ CPU，​负责​循环​控制​、​分支​、Cube/Vector/MTE ​指令​地址​和​参数​计算​。

MTE（Memory Transfer Engine）：​负责​ Global Memory/UB/L0A ​等​之间​的​数据​搬运​与​格式​转换​，​如​ padding、transpose。

L2 Buffer vs L2 Cache：​同一​介质​两种​模式​。Buffer ​程序员​可见​、​地址​空间​与​ DDR/HBM ​不​重合​；Cache ​对​程序员​不​可见​，​作为​ DDR/HBM ​高速缓存​。

docs.title: 19. CANN / MindSpore / ​图​优化
docs.text:
CANN：​介于​ AI chip ​和​ AI framework ​之间​，​提供​计算​加速​库​、​芯片​算子​库​。CUDA ​对​ NVIDIA，CANN ​对​ Ascend。

​算子​开发​：Tensor​是​存储​算子​输入​数据​与​输出​数据​的​容器​，​于​Device memory​中​；TBE DSL：Python，​高​封装​，​适合​简单​算术​逻辑​/​内置​矩阵​池化​，​入门​低​但​复杂​逻辑​受限​。TIK：Python，​直接​控制​搬运​和​ schedule，​适合​复杂​算子​，​性能​潜力​高​但​入门​难​。AI CPU：C++，​用于​ AI Core ​不易​实现​或​快速​打通​网络​，​但​性能​低​。

​图​优化​：CSE ​公共​子​表达式​消除​；​算子​融合​把​ Conv/BN/ReLU ​等​相邻​算子​合并​，​减少​中间​张量​读写​，​提高​局部性​和​带宽​利用​。MindSpore：​自动​并行​、​图算​融合​、​内存​优化​、​流水线​执行​、​自动​微分​、​类型​推导​、​二阶​优化​等​。

docs.title: 20. Parallel Training ​总览
docs.text:
Backward ​计算​约​为​ forward ​的​ 2×，​且​需要​ forward activations，​存在​ RAW dependency。​分布式​训练​动机​：​模型​大​、​数据​大​、​单卡​内存​有限​，​所以​要​scale-out。​模型​训练​4​组成​：computing, storage, networking, compiling

​并行​分类​：Data Parallel；Model Parallel → Intra-layer/Tensor Parallel, Inter-layer/Pipeline Parallel；Hybrid Parallel。

docs.title: 21. Data Parallel
docs.text:
• ​每张​卡​(worker)(​共​N​张​)​有​完整​模型​副本​，​切分​训练​数据​。​前向​/​反向​：​各卡​独立​计算​，​无需​通信​。
  • Fwd ​和​ Bwd
  • ​权重​更新​：​需对​ N ​张卡​的​梯度​求​平均​（Summing 1/N gradients），​通信​原语​为​ AllReduce。
  • Ring AllReduce: ​拓扑​1D torus(ring)；​每个​ worker ​只​和​两个​邻居​通信​;​两​阶段​：
  • Reduce-Scatter（N-1 steps）：​每步​每卡​只​负责​汇总​最终​结果​的​ 1/N ​块​。
  • AllGather（N-1 steps）：​将​汇总​好​的​块​广播​给​所有​卡​。
    • ​共​ 2(N – 1) steps, worker sends/receives 1/N of all bytes
    • ​每步​都​要​同步​ -> 2(N – 1) syncs total
  • ​单卡​(worker)​通信量​：
  • ​每轮​收发​ = M / N ​字节​（M ​为​总​数据量​）。
  • ​单卡​总​发送​ = ​单卡​总​接收​ = 2(N-1) × (M/N)。
  • ​单卡​总​吞吐​（Tx+Rx） = 2M(N-1) / N ≈ 2M（​当​ N ​较大​时​）。
  • ​扩展性​评价​(​增加​卡数​)：​强​扩展​（​固定​总​ Batch）：​每卡​ Batch ​变小​，BN ​不准​，​显存​利用率​低​。​弱​扩展​（​增大​总​ Batch）：​需​调整​ LR、​优化​器​，​收敛​至​同样​精度​ Epoch ​可能​增加​。
  • ​优点​：​通信​可​与​反向​计算​重叠​（​算​完​一层​梯度​即可​同步​该层​）。

docs.title: 22. Pipeline Parallel
docs.text:
• ​定义​：​按​网络层​切分​，​每张​卡​负责​若干层​。
  • ​通信​模式​：​点对点​（P2P）​传输​激活​值​（​前向​）​和​激活​梯度​（​反向​）。
  • ​一般​流水线​：(N-1)/N idle slots
  • gpipe: N workers, K subminibatches
    • 2(N + K – 1) steps for fwd/bwd
    • Total step-slots: 2N(N + K – 1)
    • Idle step-slots: 2N(N – 1)
    • ​空闲​率​: (N – 1)/(N + K – 1)
    • K ​越大​，​气泡​占​比越​小​；​但​当​N​增大​时​，​需同​比例​增大​K​维持​效率​
  • ​挑战​：​存在​空闲​气泡​;​各层​计算​负载​难​均衡​（​计算​量​不同​）​难​与​计算​重叠​（​顺序​依赖​，​等​上游​数据​到达​才能​计算​）

docs.title: 23. Tensor Parallel
docs.text:
• ​定义​：​将​单层​内​的​权重​矩阵​按行​或列​切分​到​多卡​
  • Row-wise：​权重​按行​切分​
    • Fwd: AllGather ​拼凑​输出​; Bwd: ReduceScatter
    • ​每卡算出​部分​行​结果​，​需​聚合​；​反向​时​梯度​需​按行​散播​累加​。
  • Column-wise：​权重​按列​切分​
    • Fwd: ReduceScatter ​累加​部分​和​; Bwd: Allgather
    • ​每卡算出​的​列​结果​需​相加​；​反向​时​需​将​完整​梯度​广播​回各列​

  • ​交替​切分​—— ​减少​通信​的​关键​

    • ​策略​：​第​ K ​层用行​并行​，​第​ K+1 ​层用​列​并行​。
    • ​通信​优化​逻辑​：​行​并行​的​输出​是​按行​切分​的​（Worker i ​持有​连续​行​区间​）。​列​并行​要求​输入​也​按行​切分​（​因为​列切​权重​与​输入​行​相乘​是​独立​的​）。
    • ​结论​：​行​并行​ → ​列​并行​，​跨层​通信​为​ 0（​无需​ AllGather ​或​ ReduceScatter）。
    • ​交替​后​的​整体​开销​：
      • ​若​顺序​为​ ​行​→​列​→​行​，​则​只有​在​列​→​行​的​边界​需要​做​一次​ AllReduce。
      • ​对比​无​交替​（​每层​都​通信​）：​同步​次数​减半​（​减少​ 50%）。

  • ​挑战​：​难​与​计算​重叠​

  • ZeRO（​零​冗余​优化​器​）：​将​优化​器​状态​（​动量​、​方差​）、​梯度​和​模型​参数​切分​到​各卡​，​解决​单卡​显存​不足​。​代价​是​增加​了​少量​通信量​。

docs.title: 24. AllReduce / Ring AllReduce（​重点​）
docs.text:
AllReduce：​每个​ worker ​起始​有​长度​ M ​的​向量​，​结束​时​每个​ worker ​都​有​全体​ worker ​的​规约​结果​（sum/avg/max）。Data parallel ​用于​梯度​平均​；tensor parallel ​也​可能​在​交替​ row/col ​时用​。

​考试​常见​判断​：​不是​所有​ worker ​两​两​互发​完整​ M。worker ​需要​ CPU/GPU cycles ​做​规约​，​可能​与​计算​重叠​但​也​可能​成为​瓶颈​。

docs.title: 26. Roofline ​例题​答案​模板
docs.text:
​题​：Conv 10000 OP /1000B，5.8 TOP/s；FC 30000/1000B，7.9；Attention 50000/1000B，6.1。​图中​峰值​ 12 TOP/s，ridge AI=20 OP/B。

​计算​：peak compute=12 TOP/s；bandwidth=12/20=0.6 TB/s=600 GB/s。AI：Conv=10，FC=30，Attention=50 OP/B。Roof ​上限​：Conv=min(12,10×0.6)=6 TOP/s；FC=12；Attention=12。

​放​点​：Conv (10,5.8) ​接近​ 6，​几乎​ fully optimized，memory-bound。FC (30,7.9) ​低于​ 12，​不​充分​，compute-bound。Attention (50,6.1) ​低于​ 12，​不​充分​，compute-bound。​若​ Conv ​另​一​实现​只是​让​计算​单元​更​快​，​吞吐​不​一定​提高​，​因为​ Conv ​已​ memory-bound；​应​优化​访存​/​提高​ AI/​减少​ bytes。

docs.title: 27. Performance Analysis ​例题​答案​模板
docs.text:
​题​：clock=2ns；load 4cyc、store 6、arith 2、branch 3；mix=20/10/50/20%。

(a) CPI=0.2×4+0.1×6+0.5×2+0.2×3=3.0。

(b) miss penalty=100ns，hit time=1 cycle=2ns，miss rate=1.4%。AMAT=2+0.014×100=3.4ns（​若​题目​把​ miss time ​当​总​ miss access，​则​ 0.986×2+0.014×100≈3.372ns，​写清​假设​）。

(c) 100 instr，avg 1.3 mem access/instr。Base=100×3×2=600ns。Miss extra=100×1.3×0.014×100=182ns。Total≈782ns。

(d) 2-way miss rate=1.0%，clock ​增​为​ 2×1.05=2.1ns。Base=100×3×2.1=630ns；miss extra=100×1.3×0.01×100=130ns；total=760ns。​所以​ 2-way ​更​快​（760ns < 782ns），​虽然​ clock ​变慢​，​但​ miss ​降低​收益​更大​。

docs.title: 28. Cache ​例题​答案​模板
docs.text:
​题​：32B cache，block=4B，byte-addressable，​序列​ 0x8,0x28,0x8,0x88,0x8,0x28。Block number=addr/4：2,10,2,34,2,10。

Direct mapped：B=8，S=8，index=block mod 8，​三者​ index ​都​是​ 2。​结果​：M(C), M(C), M(conflict), M(C), M(conflict), M(conflict)，hit rate=0/6。​第一次​访问​某​ block ​即​ compulsory，​即使​同时​造成​替换​也​优先​记​ compulsory。

2-way set associative：B=8，N=2，S=4，index=block mod 4，​三者​仍同​ set=2，​但​ set ​有​ 2 ways。LRU ​过程​：2 M；10 M；2 H；34 M evict 10；2 H；10 M(conflict)。hit rate=2/6。

Fully associative：8 ways，​三个​ block ​都​能​同时​放下​：2 M；10 M；2 H；34 M；2 H；10 H。hit rate=3/6。​最高​：fully associative。

docs.title: 29. Pipelined/OOO CPU ​例题​做法​压缩
docs.text: ​流水线​表​通用​技巧​：​若有​ RAW，​消费者​ E ​起点​ ≥ ​生产者​结果​可用​周期​；​若​ FU fully pipelined，​只​限制​ start rate；​若​ precise exception，W ​必须​严格​按程序​顺序​。in-order dispatch ​机器​中​，​前面​一条​因​ RAW ​等待​会​挡住​后面​独立​指令​；OOO ​用​ RS ​把​等待​指令​移开​。

docs.title: 30. ​考试​易错​点
docs.text:
1. tag ​不是​值​；valid=0 ​表示​等​ tag ​对应​的​未来​值​。
  2. CDB ​更新​ RF ​时​必须​检查​当前​ tag ​是否​仍​匹配​，​避免​旧​ producer ​覆盖​新​ rename。
  3. ROB ​解决​ precise exception；RS ​解决​等待​/​乱序​调度​；renaming ​解决​ WAR/WAW。
  4. Ring AllReduce ​是​ ReduceScatter + AllGather，​不是​单纯​ all-to-all。
  5. Tensor parallel ​的​ row/column ​通信​按​ PPT：row fwd Allgather，column fwd ReduceScatter；backward ​相反​；​交替​每​两层​ AllReduce。
  6. Cache miss ​分类​先看​是否​第一次​访问​ block；​直接​映射​冲突​多​，fully associative ​不​一定​现实​最快​。
  7. Coherence ​是​ same address/block；Consistency ​是​ all memory operations。
  8. Roofline ​中​实测​点​低于​ roof ​不​等于​一定​ memory-bound；bound ​看​ AI ​与​ ridge，​优化​程度​看离​ roof ​的​距离​。

docs.title: Parallel Training
docs.text:
• ​分布式​训练​原因​: larger models, datesets, memory size 80GB->scale-out
  • ​模型​训练​4​组成​：computing, storage, networking, compiling

docs.title: 数据​并行
docs.text:
• ​每张​卡​(​共​N​张​)​有​完整​模型​副本​，​切分​训练​数据​。​前向​/​反向​：​各卡​独立​计算​，​无需​通信​。
  • Fwd：
  • Bwd：
  • ​权重​更新​：​需对​ N ​张卡​的​梯度​求​平均​（Summing 1/N gradients），​通信​原语​为​ AllReduce。
  • Ring AllReduce:
  • Reduce-Scatter（N-1 ​轮​）：​每卡​只​负责​汇总​最终​结果​的​ 1/N ​块​。
  • AllGather（N-1 ​轮​）：​将​汇总​好​的​块​广播​给​所有​卡​。
    • 2(N – 1) steps, worker sends/receives 1/N of all bytes
    • Each step requires a synchronization -> 2(N – 1) syncs total
  • ​单卡​通信量​（​必背​公式​）：
  • ​每轮​收发​ = M / N ​字节​（M ​为​总​梯度​大小​）。
  • ​单卡​总​发送​ = ​单卡​总​接收​ = (N-1) × (M/N)。
  • ​单卡​总​吞吐​（Tx+Rx） = 2M(N-1) / N ≈ 2M（​当​ N ​较大​时​）。
  • ​扩展性​评价​(​增加​worker​卡数​)：​强​扩展​（​固定​总​ Batch）：​每卡​ Batch ​变小​，BN ​不准​，​显存​利用率​低​。​弱​扩展​（​增大​总​ Batch）：​需​调整​ LR、​优化​器​，​收敛​至​同样​精度​ Epoch ​可能​增加​。
  • ​优点​：​通信​可​与​反向​计算​重叠​（​算​完​一层​梯度​即可​同步​该层​）。

docs.title: 流水线​并行
docs.text:
• ​定义​：​按​网络层​切分​，​每张​卡​负责​若干层​。
  • ​通信​模式​：​点对点​（P2P）​传输​激活​值​（​前向​）​和​激活​梯度​（​反向​）。
  • ​一般​流水线​：(N-1)/N idle slots
  • gpipe: N workers, K subminibatches
    • 2(N + K – 1) steps for fwd/bwd
    • Total step-slots: 2N(N + K – 1)
    • Idle step-slots: 2N(N – 1)
    • ​空闲​率​: (N – 1)/(N + K – 1)
    • K ​越大​，​气泡​占​比越​小​；​但​当​N​增大​时​，​需同​比例​增大​K​维持​效率​
  • ​挑战​：
    • ​存在​空闲​气泡​
    • ​各层​计算​负载​难​均衡​（​计算​量​不同​）
    • ​难​与​计算​重叠​（​顺序​依赖​，​等​上游​数据​到达​才能​计算​）

docs.title: 张量​并行
docs.text:
• ​定义​：​将​单层​内​的​权重​矩阵​按行​或列​切分​到​多卡​
  • Row-wise：​权重​按行​切分​
    • Fwd: AllGather ​拼凑​输出​
    • Bwd: ReduceScatter
    • ​每卡算出​部分​行​结果​，​需​聚合​；​反向​时​梯度​需​按行​散播​累加​。
  • Column-wise：​权重​按列​切分​
    • Fwd: ReduceScatter ​累加​部分​和​
    • Bwd: Allgather
    • ​每卡算出​的​列​结果​需​相加​；​反向​时​需​将​完整​梯度​广播​回各列​
  • ​交替​切分​—— ​减少​通信​的​关键​
    • ​策略​：​第​ K ​层用行​并行​，​第​ K+1 ​层用​列​并行​。
    • ​通信​优化​逻辑​：
    • ​行​并行​的​输出​是​按行​切分​的​（Worker i ​持有​连续​行​区间​）。
    • ​列​并行​要求​输入​也​按行​切分​（​因为​列切​权重​与​输入​行​相乘​是​独立​的​）。
    • ​结论​：​行​并行​ → ​列​并行​，​跨层​通信​为​ 0（​无需​ AllGather ​或​ ReduceScatter）。
    • ​交替​后​的​整体​开销​：
      • ​若​顺序​为​ ​行​→​列​→​行​，​则​只有​在​列​→​行​的​边界​需要​做​一次​ AllReduce。
      • ​对比​无​交替​（​每层​都​通信​）：​同步​次数​减半​（​减少​ 50%）。
  • ​挑战​：​难​与​计算​重叠​
  • ZeRO（​零​冗余​优化​器​）：​将​优化​器​状态​（​动量​、​方差​）、​梯度​和​模型​参数​切分​到​各卡​，​解决​单卡​显存​不足​。​代价​是​增加​了​少量​通信量​。

docs.title: 1. ​公式​速记
docs.text:
• Amdahl：\(\mathrm{Speedup} = 1 / (1-f+f/N)\)
  • Roofline：\(AI = \mathrm{Flops}/\mathrm{Bytes}\)
  • Little's Law：​并发​度​ = ​延迟​ × ​吞吐​

docs.title: 2. ​三类​ Hazards
docs.text: 类型​ ​原因​ ​处理​ ​结构性​ ​资源​冲突​ ​加​资源​/​分离​资源​ ​数据​性​ ​指令​间​依赖​ ​转发​、​停顿​、ROB ​控制性​ ​分支​方向​未定​ ​预测​、​冲刷

docs.title: 3. ​数据​依赖
docs.text:
类型​ ​例子​ ​是否​真​相关​ ​结论​ RAW I1​写​，I2​读​ ​是​ ​只能​转发​/​停顿​ WAR I1​读​，I2​写​ ​否​ ​需​重命名​ WAW I1​写​，I2​写​ ​否​ ​需​重命名​
  • WAR​和​WAW​因​寄存器​数量​有限​导致​,​重命名​可​解决​

docs.title: 4. RAW ​的​典型​处理
docs.text:
• Forwarding / Bypass：​把​ EX/MEM/WB ​的​结果​直接​送回​ EX ​输入​。
  • ​优先级​：MEM > WB。
  • ​经典​例子​：lw -> add。lw ​结果​在​ MEM ​末​才​可用​，​不能​直接​转发​到​下​一条​ EX，​需​插入​ 1 ​个​ bubble。
  • Stall：StallF=1, StallD=1，FlushE=1。

docs.title: 5. Precise Exceptions
docs.text:
• ​异常​时​：​前面​的​指令​必须​全部​ commit，​后面​的​指令​都​不能​ commit。
  • ​目的​：​保持​冯​·​诺依曼​顺序​语义​、​便于​恢复​和​调试​。
  • ROB ​是​实现​精确​异常​的​核心​。

docs.title: 6. ROB ​工作​流程
docs.text:
1. in-order Decode：​按序​分配​ ROB entry。
  2. OoO Execute：​乱序执行​，​结果​先写​ ROB。
  3. in-order Commit：​按序​写回​寄存器​/​内存​。

docs.title: 7. ROB ​关键字​段
docs.text:
• V：​结果​是否​ ready
  • DestRegID：​目标​寄存器​
  • DestRegVal：​结果​值​
  • StoreAddr/Data：​存储​信息​
  • PC / Exception?

docs.title: 8. ROB ​的​作用​与​代价
docs.text:
• ​优点​：​支持​精确​异常​、​消除​ WAR/WAW、​适合​多​周期​执行​单元​。
  • ​缺点​：​硬件​复杂​，​读​结果​要​间接​查​ ROB，​功耗​和​面积​更大​。

docs.title: 9. ​考点​速记
docs.text:
• ​多​周期​指令​（​如​ DIV）​难点​：​后续​指令​可能​先​完成​ → ​用​ ROB ​保证​顺序​提交​。
  • lw -> and：​常考​，​需​ 1-cycle stall + forward。
  • ​异常​处理​顺序​：​冻结​/​冲刷​ → ​保证​精确​状态​ → ​保存​ PC/​寄存器​ → ​跳转​ handler。
  • ROB ​大小​：​参考​ Little's Law，​窗口​越大越​好​，​但​硬件​代价​也​越​大​。

docs.title: 1. Why OoO？
docs.text:
• In-order ​里​，​一条​长​延迟​指令​会​把​后面​的​独立​指令​也​挡住​。
  • OoO ​让​“​数据​已​就绪​”​的​指令​先​执行​，​提升​吞吐​。

docs.title: 2. ​组件
docs.text:
• RS ​缓冲​已​译码​但​未​执行​的​指令​，​等​操作数​就绪​后​发给​ FU
  • RAT(Alising Table) ​记录​寄存器​当前​对应​的​ RS Tag，​做​重命名​
  • CDB ​广播​ {Tag, Value}，​唤醒​等待​的​ RS

docs.title: (1) Issue（​译码​/​分配​）—— In-order
docs.text:
• ​检查​ RS ​是否​有​空闲​条目​；​若​无​ → Stall。
  • ​分配​ RS ​条目​（​分配​ Tag = ​条目​ ID）。
  • ​源​操作数​：
  • ​查​ RAT：​若该​寄存器​ Valid=1 → ​直接​取值​填入​ RS（.v=1）。
  • ​若​ Valid=0 → ​取​ RAT ​中​的​ Tag ​填入​ RS（.v=0），​等待​ CDB ​广播​该​ Tag。
  • ​目的​寄存器​：​将​ RAT ​中该​寄存器​项​改为​ ​当前​ RS ​条目​ Tag，​并​置​ Valid=0（​表示​值​尚未​产生​）。

docs.title: (2) RS（​等待​/​唤醒​）—— Out-of-order
docs.text:
• ​监听​ CDB，​若​广播​ Tag ​匹配​某个​源​操作数​的​ Tag → ​将值​写入​该源​，​置​ .v=1。
  • ​当​ ​所有​源​操作数​ .v=1 → ​指令​“​唤醒​ (Wakeup)”。

docs.title: (3) Execute（​执行​）
docs.text:
• ​从​唤醒​的​指令​中​选择​ (Select) ​一个​派发​到​对应​ FU（​仲裁​）。
  • FU ​执行​，​产生​结果​（​可能​多​周期​）。

docs.title: (4) Writeback (WB) —— ​广播​到​ CDB
docs.text:
• ​仲裁​获得​ CDB ​使用权​。
  • ​广播​ {Tag, Value}。
  • ​更新​ RAT：​若​ RAT ​中​某​寄存器​ Tag ​匹配​广播​ Tag → ​写入​ Value，​置​ Valid=1。
  • ​更新​ RS：​所有​ RS ​条目​中源​ Tag ​匹配​ → ​写入​ Value，​置​ .v=1。

docs.title: 4. ​寄存器​重命名​如何​消除​假​依赖​（WAR / WAW）
docs.text:
• ​示例​：ADD R5 ← R3, R4 ​和​ MUL R5 ← R6, R7（WAW）。
  • ​在​ Issue ​阶段​，​两条​指令​的​目的​寄存器​ R5 ​被​重命名​为​不同​的​ RS Tag（​如​ a ​和​ b）。
  • ​后续​读​ R5 ​的​指令​通过​ RAT ​指向​最新​的​ Tag，​因此​ WAW/WAR ​自然​消失​
  • ​本质​：RS ​条目​充当​了​无限​数量​的​“​物理​寄存器​”。

docs.title: 5. Tomasulo vs. ​记分板
docs.text:
• Scoreboard：​遇到​ WAR/WAW ​会​停顿​。
  • Tomasulo：​重命名​后​不必​停顿​，​结构​更​复杂​。

docs.title: 6. ROB-precise exception
docs.text:
• ​两​阶段​流水线​（“​双​驼峰​”）：
  • ​前段​（RS）：​乱序​派发​/​执行​（​容忍​延迟​）。
  • ​后​段​（ROB）：​乱序​完成​，​顺序​提交​ (In-order Commit)。
  • RAT ​双份​：
  • Frontend RAT (Future Map)：​指令​执行​完成​后​立即​更新​（​投机​状态​）。
  • Architectural RAT：​仅​在​ ROB ​提交​（Commit）​时​更新​（​精确​状态​）。
  • ​异常​处理​：​冲刷​投机​指令​，​将​ Architectural RAT ​复制​回​ Frontend RAT → ​恢复​精确​状态​。

docs.title: 7. ​关键​性能​限制
docs.text:
• ​指令​窗口​ = RS ​中未​发射​ + ROB ​中未​提交​的​指令​总数​。
  • ​窗口​越大​，​可​发现​的​并行性​越高​，​但​硬件​（CAM、​仲裁​）​开销​剧增​。
  • ​延迟​容忍度​：​由​窗口​大小​决定​；​若​一条​长​延迟​指令​，​需​巨大​窗口​才能​继续​填充​独立​指令​。

docs.title: Superscalar
docs.text:
① ​超标​量​（Superscalar）​核心​ ② SIMD / ​向量​（Vector） • ​定义​：​每​周期​取指​/​译码​/​执行​/​退休​ N ​条​指令​（N-wide） • Flynn ​分类​：SISD / SIMD / MISD / MIMD • ​理论​ IPC = N（​理想​情况​） • SIMD：​单指令​操作​多个​数据​元素​（​数据​级​并行​） • ​关键​瓶颈​：​并发​指令​间​的​依赖​检测​（RAW/WAR/WAW） • Intel ​实例​：AVX2（256-bit = 8​个​FP32）；AVX512（512-bit = 16​个​FP32） • ​依赖​多时​，​实际​ IPC ​大幅​下降​（​例​：​理想​ IPC=2，​因​依赖​实际​仅​ 1.2） • ​硬件​支持​：​需​额外​增加​ VRF（​向量​寄存器​） + VALU + ​向量​访存​单元​ • ​与​ OoO ​关系​：​超标​量​（​宽度​）​与​乱序​（​顺序​）​是​正交​概念​，​可​组合​ • ​主要​瓶颈​：​内存​带宽​极易​成为​限制​（​需​平衡​计算​/​访存​） • ​优点​：​吞吐量​ ↑，IPC ↑ • Roofline ​影响​：​大幅​抬高​纵轴​（​峰值​算力​），​但​受​斜线​（​带宽​）​限制​ • ​缺点​：​硬件​复杂​，​功耗​/​面积​ ↑，​关键​路径​变​长​ • Amdahl ​限制​：​向​量化​收益​受​串行​部分​比例​制约​ ③ ​多线程​（Multithreading） ④ ​多核​（Multi-Core）​与​大小​核​ • ​细粒度​（Fine-grained）：​每​周期​切换​不同​线程​ • ​多核​起因​：​单核​收益​递减​ + ​功耗​墙​ + ​复杂度​（2​次方​增长​） • ​同一​线程​最​多​ 1 ​条​指令​在​流水线​中​ • ​大核​：OoO、​宽​发射​、​深​流水​ → ​单线程​快​，​但​功耗​/​面积​巨大​ • ​优点​：​无需​依赖​检查​ / ​分支​预测​；​用​其它​线程​隐藏​延迟​ • ​小核​：In-Order、​窄​发射​、​浅​流水​ → ​吞吐​高​，​功耗​低​ • ​缺点​：​单线程​性能​ ↓；​多​硬件​上下文​（PC+Reg）；Cache​争用​ • CMP（​片内​多核​） vs CMT（CMP+MT）：​每个​核再套​多线程​ • ​经典​案例​：Sun Niagara（8​核​，​每核​4/8​路​细粒度​MT，​面向​吞吐​） • ​非对称​ ACMP：1​个大核​ + ​多个​小核​ → ​串行​段用​大核​，​并行​段用​全核​ • Roofline ​影响​：​不​改变​单核​峰值​，​但​通过​并行​提高​水平​方向​利用率​ • ​经典​案例​：Piranha（8​小核​）；IBM POWER（​大核​+SMT）；Sun ROCK（Runahead ​开发​ MLP+ILP） • ​吞吐​优先​设计​（​如​商用​负载​） vs ​延迟​优先​设计​（​如​单线程​） • Roofline ​影响​：​扩展​并行度​，​但​受​ Amdahl ​和​片外​带宽​墙​限制​

📌 ​终极​考点​速记​（​考前​提炼​） - ​超标​量​ → ​宽度​（N​路​），​瓶颈​在​依赖​检查​。 - SIMD → ​宽度​（​位​宽​），​瓶颈​在​内存​带宽​。 - ​多线程​ → ​时间​片​交错​，​掩盖​访存​延迟​，​牺牲​单核​性能​。 - ​多核​ → ​面积​换​并行​，​受​Amdahl​定律​和​存储​墙​双重​束缚​。 - ​大核​（​性能​） vs ​小核​（​吞吐​）：​现代​CPU​的​黄金​权衡​点​。
